properties.Title: Solitary Mountain
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, on low gradient beach of gravel, cobble, some boulders. NW aspect. Some weather protection. East bank of creek.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland sheltered cleared sites in open forest. Potential for many tents. Hammock opportunities. Other options along same shore.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round creek. View. Staging for tidal rapids.

properties.Title: South Curme Island
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on rock ledges or rough beaches in N or S coves which join at high water, splitting island.
properties.Camp Comments: 8 wooden tent platforms. Vault toilet. Picnic area. No fires permitted. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites. Numerous drought-killed trees reported 2023.
properties.Other Comments: Views. In Spring avoid bird nesting area on SW end. See Desolation Sound Marine Provincial ParkPark Operator: 1312768 BC Ltd email DesolationSound.Camping@outlook.com

properties.Title: Raynor Islands Central Cove
properties.Landing Comments: High water landing awkward over stacked drift logs at head of protected narrow cove. E aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: 3-4 tent sites on damp lumpy grass. Easy upland access for further sites if brushed. Likely potential for 2 or more sites. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Marginal site.

properties.Title: Cluxewe
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on exposed gravel beach. N aspect. Protected optional landing in estuary near boat launch might require mid or higher water levels.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed commercial resort, RV site. Picnic tables. Toilets.
properties.Other Comments: Water at tap. Boat launch in protected estuary. View. For details, see Cluxewe Resort.

properties.Title: Pig Ranch central
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on cobble, pebble beach. Second bay from N. Drift logs.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites in open sloped second growth forest. In 2023 only 1-2 tent sites seen. Possibly 6-8 sites if brushed lightly. Former commercial site, but platforms, structures decayed. Drift logs prevent beach camping,
properties.Other Comments: Views. Log debris. See Qwiquallaaq/Boat Bay Conservancy.

properties.Title: Edith Point east
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on low gradient beach of silt or firm mud, gravel, pebble, cobble, occasional boulders. Long but easy 50 m carry at low water. SE aspect. Protected from prevailing wind, swell. Currents.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Approx 50 m E of stream path leads into to forest clearing for 3 or more tents. Various other sites near centre bay among large conifers or alders without clearings. Another site lies by shore under large cedar just W of shoal projecting into bay. Inactive log dump nearby could yield additional sites.
properties.Other Comments: Water at stream. Attractive. Staging area for Edith Pt.

properties.Title: Hardinge Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on pebble, gravel beach at high water, much cobble, some boulders at low water. SW side of island. Exposed W aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Campsites in open forest behind the large rock at centre beach. Potential for several more sites. Hammock opportunities. ** Hazardous trees observed at here June 2020 - until situation has been remedied camping is recommended higher up slope where deadfall is less likely .**
properties.Other Comments: Wild Coast Atlas shows site in incorrect location. Sheltered anchorages at various locations. Cetan Thurston Bay Conservancy. See: Cetan Thurston Bay Conservancy.

properties.Title: Walkem Bay south
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on low gradient gravel, pebble beach. sand patches. Rougher at sides, top with cobbles, occasional boulders. Exposed to W but outer bay moderately protected.
properties.Camp Comments: Easy access to dark open forest with several level areas. Undeveloped. Some brushing, levelling needed.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Aka East Thurlow Island south.

properties.Title: Greenway Sound
properties.Landing Comments: Moderately difficult on rough rock boulder beach with boat run for low, mid water levels. Well protected. Prominent sign. Float, dock in disrepair, hazardous but not close to camping area, so not recommended.
properties.Camp Comments: Clear level grass areas upland. Pit toilet near dock. Picnic tables. Log book box needs repair, no book present 2023. Raised boardwalk hazardous due to rotting boards. Location also given as N50D 50.21M W126D 46.299M
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water at year-round creek. Hiking trail leads to lake 45 min, further lake 30 min more.

properties.Title: Care Island
properties.Landing Comments: Rough beaches to N and S of rocky promontory.  Boulders, moderate gradient at high water, clam bed lower gradient with occasional boulders. S side steeper.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Rough tent sites in second growth forest or possible bluff sites. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Fisherman Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Relatively easy landing on smooth pebble beach in partly protected cove. N aspect. Approach via centre bay through kelp. At very low water, W part of beach dries to boulders. Mostly sand bottom in centre of cove.
properties.Camp Comments: Large area of level berm with beach grass 40 m E of centre beach. Also upland site under deciduous tree W of small peninsula i.e further E. Dispersed camping permitted. Fire pit, camp furniture. Camping fees apply 1 May to 30 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at San Josef Bay trailhead, but no reservable sites.
properties.Other Comments: Rough hiking trail across peninsula to Nissen Bight. See: Cape Scott Provincial Park

properties.Title: Lemon Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on 20 m long mixed rock, gravel all-tide beach, cobbles below, scattered boulders in semi-protected cove, Open to W. W aspect. Moderately low gradient so dries far. Enter cove from W except at high water when passages between islands open. Beach mostly floods.
properties.Camp Comments: Large site in open mossy woods for several tents 20 m along trail from beach on NW bank of creek. Hammock opportunities. Additional sites could be brushed.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Logging relics, remains of cord road.

properties.Title: Cranberry Islet
properties.Landing Comments: Islet between Hull, Mistake Islands. Rocky beach or rock shelves at E end of islet. Strong winds can make landing difficult on SW side. Boat lining easy at either end of islet.
properties.Camp Comments: Pine covered islet has flat top covered with low salal. Very small flat area half way along SW side above steep shore.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View.

properties.Title: Boughey Bay entrance
properties.Landing Comments: Steep angular cobble beach at bight on E shore N of entrance to bay. W aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Right (S) of highest rivulet of creek entering beach up behind grove of cedars is small open flat area with easy access.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek, flowing during mid-July 2023 drought. Industrial road behind site.

properties.Title: Patrician Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Rock reef split cove with tombolo joining ashore. Broad beach of pebble, sand on either side of tombolo. E aspect. Well-protected from N, W.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach camping on gravel or take trails 40 m into forest leading to upland camp area that will require brushing.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Water at seasonal creek at W end of cove. Rough Tex Lyon hiking trail runs by site. Anchorage. Site appears to be just outside S boundary of Hardy Bay Recreation Reserve.

properties.Title: Masterman Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Sand, pebble, shell beach with scattered boulders in protected cove on S side. Kelp. Landing easier at mid or high water. Landing at low water is difficult on seaweed-covered boulders. S aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: White shell berm may be levelled for small beach top site. Small upland bare patch for 2 tents approx 3 m above high water. Dense vegetation.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive but rugged. Nature viewing. Bird colonies. Best avoided in Spring nesting season.

properties.Title: Attwood Bay inner north
properties.Landing Comments: 15% grade, 75 mm sharp rocks, gravel. Inner bay very sheltered. S aspect. Awkward boomsticks might be tethered on beach (2015). . Private float at shore (2022).
properties.Camp Comments: One clear all-weather site. Several more potential sites at upland margin. Ground lumpy possibly due to logging debris. Because so sheltered, might be buggy, dark
properties.Other Comments: No apparent foreshore tenure in this part of inner bay except private float likely related to saltwater recreational fishing commercial permit (2022). Anchorage.

properties.Title: Toba Inlet Entrance
properties.Landing Comments: 15%-20% grade, pea gravel up to 50-70 mm round gravel. Sheltered from inflow winds.
properties.Camp Comments: Sites at upland margin behind drift logs. Open forest might yield more sites with minor brushing. 2022 party unable to find upland sites so used marginal gravel beach sites with little high water clearance at Neaps. Beach sites likely flood at Springs.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek to N. Shaded after mid-afternoon.

properties.Title: Bend Island
properties.Landing Comments: Smooth firm clam bed mud beach with scattered cobble, boulders. Suited to all water levels.
properties.Camp Comments: Sites in forest. Lumpy terrain. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View.

properties.Title: Tribune Bay Campground
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on expansive sand beach 450 m to SE. S aspect. Campsite on beach access road - wheels useful. Off-beach to trail approx 50 m. Trail approx 70 m. Shields Road approx 300 m.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed often crowded vehicle-accessible site. Minimum 2 nights stay. Reservations recommended. Open mid-May to September. See: http://www.tribunebay.com/rates.html#map Email: info@tribunebay.com Tel: +1 250.335.2359
properties.Other Comments: On Shields Road adjacent to Tribune Bay Provincial Park - camping not permitted there. Provisions, restaurants, services nearby.

properties.Title: Cevallos Campsite
properties.Landing Comments: Land at village dock about 500m S or paddle up tidal river.
properties.Camp Comments: Vehicle accessible campground with most services. Toilets, fire pits, picnic tables. Water at tap. Picnic shelter. Laundry facilities. Fee $10 per night (2023) Separate RV site has hookups at higher cost. Operated by Village of Zeballos, Reservations: (250) 761-4229 or e-mail adminzeb@recn.ca. Attractive riverside location.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Weld Island Tombolo
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected sand, gravel beach, rougher at high water. Approach from NE or SW.
properties.Camp Comments: Small site at top of isthmus. Suited to Neaps only, floods at Springs. Sides are rock walls that will funnel wind.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive, view.

properties.Title: Carrington Lagoon Entrance
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected pebble beaches E or W of reversing falls. Drift logs on E shore. W side bank slopes more gently to upland.
properties.Camp Comments: Main camping area to E of tidal channel on grass or in forest clearings. Additional sites on W shore near picnic shelter. Pit toilet reported unusable 2021. Fire pits. Camp furniture. Site shared with hiking access users. Annual use in early August for large noisy 3 day /night gathering of approx. 100 visitors, Threats to remove public access resulting from poor visitor behaviour.
properties.Other Comments: Water location unknown but 2 creeks mapped NW of narrows. Footbridge across narrows. Easy short portage to lagoon. Extensive hiking trails. Carrington Bay Park, Strathcona Regional District. No fees (2021). See Carrington Bay Park.

properties.Title: Carrington Bay east
properties.Landing Comments:
Gravel, rubble beach, some boulders. Behind island in sheltered bay.
Float home reported 300m W.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on open grassy upland benches. Fire pit. Camp furniture. Room for more tents.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek nearby but dry in Aug 2023 drought. Carrington Bay Park, Strathcona Regional District. Web site says informal camping. Park approx 200 ha waterfront lot with sheltered lagoon. Varied forested area includes old growth, second growth. Some accumulation of beach garbage reported 2022. Please remove if you can, as some kind paddlers are steadily doing.

properties.Title: Secret Beach Campground
properties.Landing Comments: See adjacent launch site
properties.Camp Comments: 2 serviced campgrounds on either side of small creek. Gravel pads, fire pits, picnic tables. Drinking water not provided, no showers. Pit toilets. Open mid-May to mid-September. Gate locked at 11 pm nightly. Camping fee and launch fee - amount varies by season.To reserve email secretbeach@toquaht.ca or ph. 1-778-762-4433.
properties.Other Comments: From Highway 4 turn onto gravel Toquaht Bay Road. Go straight 13 km. Campground on right. Marina, separate kayak launch nearby from same entry. Owned, operated by Toquaht Nation. See: Secret Beach Campground is open May 20 to September 15, 2022. Check with Toquaht Nation to ensure openings/closing of campground.

properties.Title: Read Point east
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate gradient pebble, gravel, small cobble beach in protected bay. SW aspect. Drift logs. Between the low and high the beach becomes barnacle encrusted rocks to boulders.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped user-maintained dispersed camping. Beach sites feasible. 2 sites to W of beach. Trail leads to many more upland sites to N some needing minor brushing, levelling. Rustic furniture. Some damp or flooded areas seasonally.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal stream which runs through site. Former homestead site. Evidence of old house, buildings, fencing. See Read Island Park. Additional bay 300 m to E also reported to have camping options.

properties.Title: Doctor Bay islet
properties.Landing Comments: 20% grade, rocks to 200mm, some bedrock at foreshore, upland margin.
properties.Camp Comments: 1 site on S summit, 2 sites on N summit which is in view of residence and industrial dock, work area. Paddlers have camped on islet and on point(s) on E side of Doctor Bay. Potential camp on W side of Bay beside islet.
properties.Other Comments: Aquaculture, docks in bay. Bay, mainland to N under Crown tenure. Pictograph.

properties.Title: Chatham Channel east
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient firm clam bed with moderately steep beach of pebble, small cobble above creek mouth. S aspect. Kelp.
properties.Camp Comments: Path up midden bank near creek mouth to E. Camp in woods on top.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek, likely year-round. Flowing in drought mid-July 2023. Attractive, sunny.

properties.Title: Bunsen Beach
properties.Landing Comments: 20% slope, rough, rocks to 300 mm. Boulders at lower water levels. Oyster band at low water, Currents.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Would yield 2 further upland campsites with brushing of dense vegetation. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: View. Small trails through site.

properties.Title: Cooper Point
properties.Landing Comments: Easy at low water on protected clam bed beach at cove head to SW of Point. Rougher band with cobble, rubble, boulders at mid, high water levels. Near centre of Upper Okisollo Rapids so be aware of very strong currents.
properties.Camp Comments: Treeless islet with cobble tombolo joins to Quadra Island. Camping or day use on W side of islet at grassy point. Cove head immediately W also has sites in protected forest clearing or at Neaps on upper beach, likely preferable to tombolo. Possible former cabin location.
properties.Other Comments: Stream shown on topo map entering beach but not reported. Some private land to S. Beach fires are banned all year round.

properties.Title: Waddington Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate gradient smooth shell beach in protected bay. SE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Large accessible but rough upland area. High bench just inside trees. Small tent sites in open forest, mostly uneven. Small trails link some sites. Many blowdowns. Some reporters used landing, sites approx. 100 m to NW. Hammock opportunities. Many additional tent sites with brushing.
properties.Other Comments: Some parts used for cedar bark harvest. Anchorage, Provincial Boat Haven. Broughton Archipelago Conservancy.

properties.Title: Retreat Passage south
properties.Landing Comments: Clam bed in protected bay with NW aspect dries to smooth firm mud with scattered boulders. Beach smoother in centre.
properties.Camp Comments: Old stump on beach has salal growing on top. Half way along beach SW of stump path leads 15 m to spacious flat site in old second growth forest. Other small tent sites. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Water at small seasonal creek at head of bay, dry in drought of mid-July 2023.

properties.Title: Tiber Bay Islet
properties.Landing Comments: Rock shelf or boulder landing on small rocky promontory on E shore of N islet. SE aspect. Better landing on W side of islet at notch.
properties.Camp Comments: Exposed mossy rock flat lacks trees. Potential treed or mossy rock bluff sites elsewhere on islet.
properties.Other Comments: View. Sign nearby on S islet says Klahoose Oyster Lease. Islet dries on S shore.

properties.Title: Wharf Avenue Portage
properties.Landing Comments: From beach at Trail Bay S node of portage, short 15% slope concrete ramp, slight slope down, and then 1.4 km level paved sidewalk to moderate gradient paved launch at Porpoise Bay Wharf on Sechelt, Inlet N node of portage.
properties.Camp Comments: No camping.
properties.Other Comments: Follow Wharf Avenue directly N, keeping to sidewalk except at first parking lot. Be aware of pedestrians, controlled highway crossing in the 2nd block through town. Remainder is level sidewalk. Simple, minimal physical exertion required compared to many other portages or ferry walk-offs. Enables extensive circle tour of Sechelt peninsula.

properties.Title: tsukwum UREP
properties.Landing Comments: From seaward enter narrow breakwater gap into small protected estuary or creek mouth,  S aspect. Dries to mud so might not be usable at low water. Likely easier access directly off the Strait on moderately steep beach of pebble, cobble with some drift logs. Beach lies adjacent to creek mouth  to E of gap. SE aspect. Exposed. Beach 10% gradient, sand, gravel, round smooth cobbles to 100 mm.
properties.Camp Comments: Level upland with scrubby vegetation that would require minor brushing. Several small tent sites possible for emergency use or to break this long section of Salish Sea Marine Trail. No facilities. No fires.
properties.Other Comments: New marina, multi-tenant housing and other land nearby owned by shíshálh First Nation who do not want recreational use here but cite environmental reasons relating to creek and estuary habitat. Site has water access only. Overlooked by residences. Sufficient privacy for sanitation purposes might be an issue. UREP 931505 (2021) site - emergency use only. Former name Wilson Creek UREP

properties.Title: Walkem Bay north
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on moderate gradient pebble, sand beach. Currents. W aspect. Bay is generally protected.
properties.Camp Comments: Sites in sloped open cedar forest may require minor brushing, levelling. Access through dense salal vegetation band at beach top. No feasible beach camping at most tide levels.
properties.Other Comments: Previously named East Thurlow Island west 2, Walkem Islands inside 2

properties.Title: Little Espinosa Inlet east
properties.Landing Comments: Gravel boat ramp in sheltered inlet. Exit from W end best timed for slack water to avoid strong rapids flowing under road bridge at mid-tides.
properties.Camp Comments: Small site along short level gravel road, suited to drive-in camping or RVs. 2 fire pits. Additional sites for tents subject to brushing, mowing grass. Pit toilet.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. 9 km SW of Zeballos on gravel road. Past viewpoint overlooking Zeballos, Zeballos Inlet, road veers sharply right. Access road at sign on right.

properties.Title: Hanna Point east
properties.Landing Comments: Easy landing on moderately steep beach of smooth pebble at high water with low sea state. Weed-covered smooth rocks below pebble beach at low water. SE aspect, Expect surf if swell is from S, Hanna Point protects beach from W.
properties.Camp Comments: Roomy beach site on pebbles. Dispersed camping permitted. Camping fees apply 1 May to 30 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at San Josef Bay trailhead, but no reservable sites.
properties.Other Comments: Water reported nearby but location unknown, See: Cape Scott Provincial Park

properties.Title: Rough Islets
properties.Landing Comments: Narrow boat run on cobble beach to E of  site, Larger boulders at alternate landing on W side.
properties.Camp Comments: Trails on peninsula lead through salal to grass or forested sites. 4 large wooden tent platforms, some repaired by BC Parks. Usable. Other grassy areas appear damp. Kitchen structure in poor condition. Picnic table, fire pit.
properties.Other Comments: Trail to Maggy Point site with composting toilet. Wildlife viewing. Adjacent to park but outside it. See Broughton Archipelago Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Hudson Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on moderate gradient firm pebble, gravel, sand beach in protected bay. 30cm boulders at low water. E aspect. Many drift logs, snags at high water. Summer 2024 large tree/log blocks most of upper beach at high water.
properties.Camp Comments: Minor brushing required in upland forest for one tent site - others are normally clear. Beach camp possible on gravel. Good tree for bear hang.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Trail across isthmus. See Broughton Archipelago Park.

properties.Title: Bonner Islet west
properties.Landing Comments: Possible surf landing above 2 - 2.5 m tides.  Can be exposed to inflow winds.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach camping. Upper sites reported to not flood at springs. Tombolo 60 m to S might be used by some parties.
properties.Other Comments: Water at E beach via trail. View of Brooks Peninsula, sea state.

properties.Title: Zacharias Bay Harbour Island
properties.Landing Comments: Sand beach. SW aspect. Protected by island, reefs, rocks at both narrow bay entrances, subject to swell, turbulence. Could be tough getting out in big swell and west wind
properties.Camp Comments: One cleared upland forest site, one beach site. No other facilities. Sheltered.
properties.Other Comments: Harbour Island Recreation Res REC6626 with active status is half of island. Area 15 Ha.

properties.Title: Jack Point
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient rock shelf with small sand, gravel areas. In Nanaimo River estuary. E aspect. Access tide dependent as estuary dries far. Critical tide height not yet determined. Observed, used at depths over 3.1 m. Likely feasible down to 2.0 m. At some water levels a beach approx 100 m to N offers easier landing. Connection is by a relatively smooth trail with minor stair, feasible with unloaded boats.
properties.Camp Comments: No camping permitted.
properties.Other Comments: To reach Duke Point Ferry Terminal from landing, head E approx 40 m on good trail until short stair- unload boat here - leads to paved parking lot (40 m, re-load boat), opposite main entry to Canadian Forest Products mill. No barrier to Duke Pt Highway (2019). Walk N 750 m on south bound bicycle lane to passenger terminal for tickets. Access to bicycle etc ramp N of building but requires wide gate to be unlocked - regular man-gate too narrow. Steep ramp leads to vehicle ramp, ferry deck. Wheels required. City of Nanaimo park, heavily used by walkers.

properties.Title: Long Bay South Thormanby
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate gradient beach of mixed angular small rocks at head of long, steep-walled cove. Good protection except from SE. Many drift logs. SE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Two sites - at centre bay on level rock platform or table - on grassy shelf near Farm Bay trail end in NE corner - each for 2-3 tents. Upland fire rings. Additional tent sites with minor brushing, approx 150 m up trail leading to Farm Bay. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive, Trail leads inland, connecting to beaver pond, Farm Bay & Park trail network. Water at small seasonal stream or walk 7 min. to pond. Anchorage. Bay tends to collect marine debris. Also known as Table Bay. See Simson Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Kirby Point north
properties.Landing Comments: Beach of mud, rock, boulders. NE aspect. Gradient: 5 - 15%. Easy on sand at high water. Poor access at low water when better landing is at Kirby Point southwest.  Unload boats on water. Launch loaded boats at mid-high tide level. Rock hazards, long reef at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Beautiful flat cleared forest between two beaches. Open Huu-ay-aht Treaty Settlement Land. This site appears to be fairly heavily used by the First Nation. Permit required. See: https://huuayaht.org/camping-permit-application. Two cabins, cook shelter, 2 toilets,
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Huu-at-aht cemetery located between the two beaches.At one time served as Huu-ay-aht youth camp.

properties.Title: Edward King Island northeast
properties.Landing Comments: Boulder, bedrock, sand beach of 5 - 15 % slope, N aspect. Access from N or S but channel dries at low water, when best approach is from NW. Boat run cleared through bigger rocks. Landing on SE has longer carry over cobbles.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on beach at most tides. Additional sites in.open, old growth forest.
properties.Other Comments: CMTs. Blow hole accessible at low water. Rock ledge to Haines Island dries at low water. Two sources of water reported on SE shore of same island.

properties.Title: Newton Cove north
properties.Landing Comments: E side of bay with S aspect. Protected beach of grit, gravel, small rocks at low water, cobble band at high water.
properties.Camp Comments: Upper beach sites under trees appear to be dry at most water levels. Small upland sites in level forest subject to brushing. Access from beach awkward due to deadfall, drift logs that could be cut. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Protected location with good potential in popular paddling area.

properties.Title: St Pauls Dome
properties.Landing Comments: W aspect sand, silt beach. Protected SE through SW. Surf likely in NW conditions. Likely to flood at Springs. Rock outcrops along beach at some water levels.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp at Neaps on dead beach grass, dry weed or sand. Dense vegetation at forest margin with no obvious clearings. Small sites among drift logs.
properties.Other Comments: Shaded at S end of beach. Trees for hanging food.

properties.Title: Garden Point east
properties.Landing Comments: Very low gradient sand, grit creek delta beach with some gravel, areas of rocks to 15 cm near creek mouth. Long carry at low water. N asepct. Good protection from W.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland sites in small clearings. 3-4 beach sites E of creek. E site quieter so serves as overflow for main site at base of tombolo to W of creek. Gloomy N aspect.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round Brodick Creek alongside site. Attractive. E end of Esperanza Inlet funnels winds, while W Inlet has lower winds. This site is located within the Nuchatlaht Nation's Aboriginal Title Lands. See map of the Title area here. Look up term of Aboriginal Title lands in our glossary.

properties.Title: Espinosa Inlet
properties.Landing Comments: Beach of rough cobble W aspect. Somewhat exposed to winds entering from Esperanza Inlet. Beach appears to be dry at most normal water levels.
properties.Camp Comments: Two or more level areas at top of beach on cobble. Dense vegetation at forest margin. Potential for upland sites with some brushing.
properties.Other Comments: Old logging road may enter here, but not seen. Not as good as nearby Espinosa Inlet north.

properties.Title: Commerell Point
properties.Landing Comments: Gravel, sand beach. N aspect. Easier landing than Paddler's Beach located 0.5 NM to N due to more protection from W, NW.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach camping. Possible upland sites in forest. Camping fees apply 1 May to 30 September. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2018) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
properties.Other Comments: See: Raft Cove Provincial Park..

properties.Title: Lawn Point Islet
properties.Landing Comments: All-weather landing on sand beach in protected cove between islet, main Vancouver Island shore. ENE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: NE sand beach has several large rocks for wind shelter. Sand berm across centre has protective log. No upland forest sites found. Reported location is N50D 20.2758M,W12D 59.3622M
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Islet approx 500 x 100 m. Provincial Park excludes these islets.

properties.Title: Ewin Inlet Head
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered low gradient shell, pebble, gravel beach in long bay. Scattered boulders. E aspect. 25 m N of creek mouth on W shore near bay head.
properties.Camp Comments: Natural site with no development. 2 sheltered upland tent sites in open area with ferns, close to beach. 3 further sites possible with minor brushing, levelling. Hammock opportunities. Gloomy, damp.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round creek immediately to S, flowing from lake to WNW. Anchorage. See: Bligh Island Marine Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Ucluelet Campground
properties.Landing Comments: Protected adjacent lagoon/basin or Pat Leslie Memorial Boat Launch approx 200 m distant..
properties.Camp Comments: Mix of treed tent and more cramped RV sites. Full facilities. Fees charged. Water, electric, sewer available. Showers, flush toilets. Phone 250-726-4355 Email camp@uclueletcampground.com http://www.uclueletcampground.com/
properties.Other Comments: 260 Seaplane Base Rd, Close to boat launch.

properties.Title: Fillongley
properties.Landing Comments: Gravel, sand, shingle beach. Open E aspect. Mostly low gradient, dries far at low water. Easy shore access from vehicles but 300 m carry at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Small sites adjacent to shore suited to vehicle access, all reservable. Vault toilets, picnic tables, fire rings.
properties.Other Comments: Water at tap 50 m from campground. Parking. Extensive hiking trails. Parking lot does not permit overnight parking. See: Fillongley Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Bradsdadsland
properties.Landing Comments: See nearby Phipps Point but low water use likely impractical due to low gradient rocky foreshore.
properties.Camp Comments: RV & tent sites, some with electricity. Flush and pit toilets, showers, laundry. Playground, store. Family oriented. Reservations strongly recommended Ph (250) 335-0757. Email bradsdadsland@telus.net
properties.Other Comments: 2105 Shingle Spit Road Hornby Island BC V0R 1Z0. 350 m waterfront.

properties.Title: Heriot Bay Inn
properties.Landing Comments: Protected small mixed stone beach or adjacent floats.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent, RV sites some leased long term. In attractive grassed grounds of Inn with mature trees on bank overlooking harbour. Flush toilets, showers, laundry. picnic tables, fire pits.
properties.Other Comments: Water at tap. View. Historic Heriot Bay Inn, pub, restaurant. Marina, fuel, public dock. Parking. Ferry terminal to Cortes Island nearby. For details, see Heriot Bay Inn. Beach fires are banned all year round.

properties.Title: Michigan Beach west
properties.Landing Comments: Small sand beach S aspect E of Pachena Point, W of Michigan Beach,  Some shelter in rough conditions. . Beach mostly floods at high water but not completely. Favour N end staying 50 - 75 m from large rock shelf on starboard. SW end of beach is rock strewn. See image for route.
properties.Camp Comments: Emergency pullout site. No known camping. Camping not permitted by Parks Canada nor are planned landings.
properties.Other Comments: Not on West Coast (hiking) Trail. Landing or camping on the West Coast Trail is not permitted and could result in fines, except in emergency situations.

properties.Title: Helby Island
properties.Landing Comments: Directly W of northernmost point of island, All tide sand beach of moderate gradient in generally rock shelf shore. W or NW asoect. Land in front of cabin, huu au aht signage. Low water recommended for approach. Reefs offer protection. Another beach to E closer to the N point offers similar but rougher landing.
properties.Camp Comments: Many upland tent sites, some beach sites at Neaps. Toilet reported but not seen. Permit required for overnight use. See: Camping Permit.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water at small seasonal streams to W. Small cabin visible. Huu-ay-aht Treaty Settlement Land.

properties.Title: Wishart Island east
properties.Landing Comments: Protected low gradient clam bed beach of sand, mixed rocks, scattered boulders. SE aspect. Accessible also from N but not favoured.
properties.Camp Comments: 3-4 lumpy tent sites on long grass at forest margin above beach. Likely usable with minor levelling. Upland accessible with brushing for potential additional tent, hammock sites.
properties.Other Comments: Anchorage. Wishart Island reported to have a R Washburne cabin - location, condition unknown. See Mahpahkum-Ahkwuna/Deserters-Walker Conservancy.

properties.Title: Uncle Johns Cabin
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient protected clam bed beach with scattered boulders. Boat run at mid water levels avoids some boulders. Up to 200 m carry on firm mud at low water. High water approach better - only short carry through a few bushes to cabin.
properties.Camp Comments: Cabin derelict, scheduled to be demolished 2013, but still standing in 2024. Currently no clearings in salal (2024). Some brushing possibly required to reach cabin from beach due to berry bush growth but access achieved easily 2024. Some space for tents near cabin if brushed. 3 additional tent sites on gravel beach top at Neaps, but might flood at Springs.
properties.Other Comments: No water source seen but likely present. See Mahpahkum-Ahkwuna/Deserters-Walker Conservancy.

properties.Title: Spencer Cove WFP Campground
properties.Landing Comments: Protected cove. Mixed gravel, mud beach. Ramp reported for small boats. High water preferred for launch, landing, maybe because of mud. W aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Level grass clearings. Vehicle accessible sites including RVs. Picnic tables. Fire pits. User maintained. Updated July 2025 Two outhouses, both in need of repair - door hinge missing, toilet seats broken, overfull pits - and filthy.
properties.Other Comments: Koprino Rd, Quatsino. About an hour’s drive from Holberg on active logging roads. WFP is using private radio channels so even having a mobile radio doesn’t help with road safety. Small dock reported but not confirmed. Anchorage. Vehicle access, ramp means heavy summer use by fishers. Parking unknown if not camping at site.

properties.Title: Fair Harbour Marina and Campground
properties.Landing Comments: See Fair Harbour (launch) site. Concrete or gravel boat ramps near dock, fuel float 300 m to W. Rougher landings directly at campground, easier at high water.
properties.Camp Comments: Busy developed vehicle-accessible campground, near to inlet head, with feasible water transport access. Fire rings, picnic tables. Pit toilets. Other services 250 m to W at store. Reservable. See fairharbourbc.com for details.
properties.Other Comments: Services in Fair Harbour include: campground, rental cabins, store, washrooms, showers, laundry, fuel dock, potable water, propane, paid supervised parking with video surveillance, community free parking area. Campsites range from $20 - $25/night. Daily, weekly and monthly parking rates. Water at tap. Wifi/phone available near store. Private parking lot by store provides some vehicle protection. Article on Water Taxis. Visit Fair Harbour campground website..Visit Fair Harbour campground website.

properties.Title: Simoom Sound Head
properties.Landing Comments: Clam bed beach of angular cobble, some boulders. Smooth rock shelves at sides.
properties.Camp Comments: Grass at forest margin. Other grass sites damp. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Portage to Shawl Bay takes about 1 hr.

properties.Title: Turnour Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on moderate gradient gravel beach with boulders, smaller rocks on lower beach. Located in big bay, SW aspect. Alternative landings on steep banks at inactive log dump to S at Air Point or to W on E bank of bay at old road spur.
properties.Camp Comments: Opening gives easy access to upland open forest, with some clear level areas. Additional sites at road end of inactive log dump located on E bank of bay. Minor brushing might be needed. Old vehicles, some debris.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round stream entering bay may be located from logging road bridge upstream approx 200 m. Flowing during mid-July 2023 drought. Log dump to S. Logged behind.

properties.Title: Reid Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient clam bed rocky beach with mostly angular cobble surface rock in large bay.  E aspect. Protected from most winds. Long carry at low water can be avoided by landing on N shore.
properties.Camp Comments: A few forest tent sites, subject to brushing. Hammock opportunities. A couple of sites on beach-top grass edge. Delta of creek likely to be damp in wet weather.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Water at seasonal stream with flow during mid-July 2023 drought.

properties.Title: Tsusiat Landing
properties.Landing Comments: A huge rock blocks SW swell. Huge waves may enter this bay 20-50 m E of rock, but keeping rock 10-20 m to port avoid them. Rock connects to shore at low water by a rock shelf.  High water sand landing becomes boulder strewn rock shelf at low water, so plan for tides above 1.5 m, ideally 2.0 m.
properties.Camp Comments: Not an established Parks Canada site but occasionally used as campsite. Tsusiat Falls site lies 850 m NW. Both have similar sand beaches. Camping fees charged.
properties.Other Comments: Water at falls 730 m to NW. Landing or camping on the West Coast Trail is not permitted and could result in fines, except in emergency situations.

properties.Title: Port Browning Marina
properties.Landing Comments: See launch site nearby for details.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp in grass field adjacent to pub, restaurant with some trees at perimeter. Individual or 2 group sites, all reservable. Fees (2023) individual orchard site for up to 2 tents $65. Group site for 3-4 tents $90-135. Lower shoulder season rates. Flush toilets, showers. Ph (250) 629.3493. See: Port Browning Marina and Resort. Ten minute walk to grocery store, pharmacy, liquor, hardware, bakery.
properties.Other Comments: Pub, restaurant, marina, parking. laundry. Kayak rentals adjacent, guiding outfitting. 10 min. walk to shops: grocery, pharmacy, liquor, hardware, bakery.

properties.Title: Island View
properties.Landing Comments: See Island View Beach launch site. More sand than at day launch area.
properties.Camp Comments: Vehicle accessible campground for RVs, tents. No reservations. Open from Victoria Day May long weekend to Labour Day Sept long weekend. $15 per night tenting fee (2018). Tents in section farthest from beach - approx. 150 m. Portable toilets, picnic areas, group fire ring.
properties.Other Comments: Water at taps. Walking trails. 48 ha. Dunes. Birding. View. See: Island View Beach Regional Park.

properties.Title: Maquinna
properties.Landing Comments: This cove is very protected. When approaching from the south, there appeared to be boomers and rocks near the entrance, but there was open access into the cove and the kelp beds keep the surf down; better access is from the north side of the cove; the south side has more rocks.
properties.Camp Comments: Good refuge with a moderately sloped beach and pebble beach or upland camping for at least 4 tents. There is a good creek at the south end of the cove.
properties.Other Comments: See:

properties.Title: Clo oose
properties.Landing Comments: Sand beach. S aspect. Mostly well-protected. Moderate shelter in heavy W swell conditions. Follow N along narrow rock reef to W corner of bay.
properties.Camp Comments: Any planned landing visit requires prior permission of Ditidaht Nation.
properties.Other Comments: Seasonal stream. Water year-round at Cheewhat River accessible overland but likely brackish until far above footbridge. 3 old cabins near stream at E end believed not regularly inhabited. Landing or camping on the West Coast Trail is not permitted and could result in fines, except in emergency situations.

properties.Title: Miracle Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient sand beach, cobble at high water, rocky patches. NE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed vehicle access campground. Gravel drive-in sites approx 350 m or more from beach. Wheels advisable. Pit and flush toilets. Group sites. Hot showers. Picnic shelters. Reservations recommended. Limited services in winter.
properties.Other Comments: 137 ha. Water at taps. Parking. Nature house. Swimming, change room. See: Miracle Beach Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Sombrio Beach east
properties.Landing Comments: Aim for the NW corner of small bay keeping large rock just on left side. Preferable landing to river mouth in surf conditions. Exposed rock shelf at water levels below 1 m makes landing more difficult. See image for route.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach sites. Toilet. Food storage bin. Dispersed camping permitted on beach only. Camping fees apply year-round. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $10.00 per adult per night (2018) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
properties.Other Comments: Water at stream about 50 m E of landing. Beach often used by hikers. Quieter than beach to W. Lies on Juan de Fuca hiking trail. See: Juan de Fuca Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Hardy Island
properties.Landing Comments: Bedrock ledges at entrance to sheltered cove.  Rough beach with sharp rocks to 200 mm.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. No developed trails. Limited number of small level walk-in sites on rock ledges in bluffs. Main tent site sometimes used by paddlers lies above E tip of Musket Island.
properties.Other Comments: Anchorage, Provincial Boat Haven. Most of 17 ha park lies on Hardy Island. Small Musket Island is separated from Hardy Island only at mid or higher tide. Aka Musket Island. Popular with boaters for swimming, viewing, diving, fishing, wilderness camping. Not set up for paddlers. See Hardy Island Marine Provincial Park

properties.Title: Shelter Point
properties.Landing Comments: Two long beaches 2 km. Sheltered but low gradient S and open, steeper W aspects. Sand, gravel. Concrete boat ramp, second unpaved ramp.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed in 2 locations for RVs, tents. Picnic tables, shelter, fire pits, showers, flush toilets, playground. Some sites close to beach. 2 group sites reservable, others not. Some facilities open only mid April – mid October. Fees charged. Gates locked at night. On-site caretaker 604 486-7228 or email shelterpointpark@qathet.ca
properties.Other Comments: Potable water. Boat launches. Parking. Nature trail. Food sales concession (seasonal). qathet Regional District Park. See: See Shelter Point Regional Park

properties.Title: Shingle Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on moderately steep gravel beach, exposed to S, SE.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed. Upland sites near beach with tables mainly intended for RVs. Pit toilets. Picnic shelters, other structures. Campsite summer host. Camping, parking fees $18/site/per night (2023). Reserve up to 60 days ahead.
properties.Other Comments: Water at tap. View. Attractive. Parking. Cliffs adjacent. See: Shingle Beach Campground

properties.Title: Pebbly Beach South Thormanby
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected smooth pebble, gravel beach of moderate to steep gradient. Some broken cobble at low water. E aspect. Drift logs can impede landing at very high water above 4.4 m. Prominent park sign. Vessel traffic, currents in adjacent Welcome Passage. Beware of ship wash.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped site. Small uneven grassed area among alders. Hammock opportunities. Picnic table. Tends to be damp. E aspect so shaded after noon.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Extensive hiking trails including loop to Spyglass Hill. See Simson Provincial Park

properties.Title: Farm Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on moderate gradient broken cobble, pebble beach in narrow cove.  Slightly exposed SE aspect. Well protected from other directions. Many drift logs, flotsam potentially awkward at high water. Prominent white park 'dogwood' sign to N on low cliff near cove entrance.
properties.Camp Comments: Campsite in roomy, grassy upland along former roadway, but sloped. Picnic table. No fires permitted but sign no longer present (2024). Hammock opportunities nearby.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water year-round at beaver pond 200 m NW. Wildlife viewing. Potential additional tent sites at adjacent former farm site near Park kiosk. Extensive hiking trails. See Simson Provincial Park Also known as Alder Bay.

properties.Title: Simson Central
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on moderate gradient large protected beach of small rocks. Protected E aspect. Many drift logs. Rough trails cross small marsh behind beach in front of upland.
properties.Camp Comments: Slightly lumpy sloping grass meadow, old roadbed offers several sites subject to minor levelling. Some drainage flows through site. Hammock opportunities. One high bluff tent pad. Numerous hazardous dead alder snags suggest avoiding during high winds.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water at seasonal stream. Extensive hiking trails throughout Park, including to Spyglass Hill. See Simson Provincial Park Also known as Drift Bay,

properties.Title: Home Bay Jedediah Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on firm mud with fine sand at top in protected cove. To avoid drying mudflats with embedded oysters, time landings for water levels 2.0 m or higher.
properties.Camp Comments: Dispersed camping permitted on roomy, grassy site. 2 semi-developed sites, one near beach SE of orchard, one near orchard, homestead. Possible overflow sites nearby. Composting toilet. Camping fees apply 15 May to 15 September. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2024) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration.
properties.Other Comments: Anchorages. 3.5 km of hiking trails. Historic farm, orchard. Feral sheep. Warm water swimming. Aka Sand Beach. See Jedediah Island Provincial Marine Park

properties.Title: Mermaid Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Rocky beach. Paddlecraft may be launched at protected small ramp designed for disabled scuba divers giving water access approx 70 m from vehicle access. Nearby small cove also suitable, even more protected. S aspect. Vehicle access close to shore for boat pick up or drop off.
properties.Camp Comments: Most sites set up for vehicle camping. Pit toilets, showers, change rooms. 15 sites may be reserved 1-800-689-9025. Fees charged.
properties.Other Comments: View. Water at 5 taps in summer only. Walking trails. Wildlife viewing. Popular with scuba divers. Underwater bronze mermaid statue. Separate day use area, boat ramp, 1.5 km to W. Aquaculture operation close by. See Saltery Bay Provincial Park

properties.Title: Plumper Cove Keats Island Chaich-Ph
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on small sheltered gravel beach adjacent to numerous floats, dock. S aspect. Landing option on beach with N aspect. Stowage for portable boats at beach top. Access up bank easier on N beach.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed sites of packed soil, gravel in open treed area with central grass clearing. 5 sites are large. Fire rings, picnic tables. 4 pit toilets. Reservable group site also available. Some sites have S exposure, others on N slope. Mostly shaded. Fees charged.$16 per night per party (2023). Resident attendant. Winter camping with reduced services. Separate picnic area,
properties.Other Comments: Water at hand pump seasonally. Large dock, anchorage, mooring buoys. Swimming. 2 km hiking trail to small seasonal store, foot ferry, dock at Keats Landing. Squamish (Coast Salish) name Chaich-Ph. See Plumper Cove Marine Provincial Park

properties.Title: Halkett Bay Ch’á7elsem
properties.Landing Comments: On W shore 200 m before head of protected bay. Low water access on E side of rock islet. Beach of sand, gravel pebble beside dock at high water, gravel, cobble to 100 mm S of creek. Some mud, mixed rocks at low water. S aspect. Park dock, float if present gives good access but not adjacent to sites.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed sites some on 8 wooden platforms in semi-open meadow with sword ferns, grass. Pit toilet. Some picnic tables. Food storage bin. No fires. Some additional sites muddy in wet weather. Several unsanctioned overflow sites also regularly used. Camping fees apply year-round. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2025) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
properties.Other Comments: Water at small waterfall at seasonal creek 5 min uphill from camp. Attractive. Extensive hiking trails. Dinghy dock under repair or removed 2025. Anchorage. Squamish (Coast Salish) name Ch’á7elsem. See Halkett Bay Provincial Marine Park

properties.Title: Porteau Cove Xwáŵchayay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on mud, sand, rubble in sheltered cove or on exposed cobble, pebble outer beach. Lirrle or no foreshore at high water. See also Porteau Cove launch site description.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed campground, reservations strongly recommended, walk-in sites 100% reservable. Toilets, picnic tables, shelter, fire pits, benches, showers, changing room.
properties.Other Comments: Water at taps. Parking. Views. Noise from adjacent railway, highway. Anchorage. Short hiking trails. Squamish (Coast Salish) name Xwáŵchayay. See Porteau Cove Provincial Park

properties.Title: Bold Head Pekwesqan
properties.Landing Comments: Difficult landing in bay to W with exposed SW aspect on small boulders or to SW (also SW aspect) on rock ledges or boulder beach of peninsula under Bold Head cliffs. May be difficult in W wind.
properties.Camp Comments: 9 raised wooden tent platforms on clear level areas on rock headland. Vault toilet. No fires. Exposed to W. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites.
properties.Other Comments: View. See Desolation Sound Marine Provincial Park

properties.Title: Curme Islands east
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on rock shelf, small beach in central drying cove between W, E islands. Reefs.
properties.Camp Comments: 12 wooden tent platforms on rocky shelves among low bluffs. S or E aspect. Toilet, picnic area. No fires permitted. Foot access at low and mid tides only to West Curme Island. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites.
properties.Other Comments: View. See Desolation Sound Marine Provincial ParkPark Operator: 1312768 BC Ltd email DesolationSound.Camping@outlook.com

properties.Title: Tenedos Bay Kumken
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on mixed beach in protected bay. W aspect. Cleared boat run. Beach largely floods at Springs.
properties.Camp Comments: Protected all weather site. 3 raised wooden tent platforms, cleared grass areas. Vault toilet. Picnic area. Fire rings. Interpretive sign. Suitable for group. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites. Food cache above the tent platforms on the right.
properties.Other Comments: Year-round stream flows nearby. Short hiking trail to lake swimming. Popular anchorage. See Desolation Sound Marine Provincial Park

properties.Title: Hare Point Maseqw
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on 2 sheltered rough beaches of pebble, larger stones on W (SW aspect) and E (SE aspect) sides of small peninsula. E side with boat run, smaller stones usually preferred. Strong currents, turbulence at tide changes.
properties.Camp Comments: 17 wooden tent platforms. 2 toilets. Picnic area. No fires. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites.
properties.Other Comments: View. Also known as Maseqw or Purple Urchin. See Desolation Sound Marine Provincial Park. Sometimes overcrowded.

properties.Title: Feather Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on beach of angular cobble at low water, smoother pebble above. Gentle gradient. Exposed to N but otherwise protected. N aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Sites in trees with 9 tent platforms on E headland. Metal food bin. Toilet. No fires. Beach camping possible also at neaps only. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites.
properties.Other Comments: Site shared with branch of Sunshine Coast hiking Trail. See Malaspina Provincial Park

properties.Title: Wishart Whale Tail
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered bays around whale-tail-shaped isthmus. Various easy approaches onto low gradient pebble, mud or clam bed beaches. Drift logs.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered, undeveloped. Pebbly upper beach sites for 2-3 tents at Neaps but unreliable at Springs. Easy upland access but dense vegetation. Possible upland sites if brushed. Hammock opportunities. Other tent sites might be found nearby with more searching. Possible camp at neck of isthmus. Wishart Island reported to have a R Washburne cabin - location, condition unknown.
properties.Other Comments: See Mahpahkum-Ahkwuna/Deserters-Walker Conservancy.

properties.Title: Boyles Point
properties.Landing Comments: Land on 25 m band of sand at centre beach of long bay N of point. Cobble, boulders to 30 cm at sides or at mid or high water. Enter bay to E of boomer. Reefs give some protection from E, otherwise well sheltered. Strong currents in Wells Passage. Abundant drift logs. Paddlers may prefer to land at hung small float marker nearer rocky point for easier high water tent site access.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland site for 2 tents 30 m behind point or rock bluff at S end of beach. Look for hung float. Additional small upland sites in forest 50 m -100 m further N if brushed of salal. Drift logs hinder access. Some users have camped on flat rock ledges to W of point.
properties.Other Comments: 1 NM to N, Kenneth R in Kenneth Bay offers possible water source, but access not verified.

properties.Title: Cattle Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on shell, sand beach W aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered, undeveloped. Large forested upland site reached from S end of beach along shell trail. Suited to small groups. Additional beach camping except at Springs. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive but beach visible from Fort Rupert 0.8 NM away. Shellfish aquaculture floats offshore nearby.

properties.Title: Bere Point
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate to steep cobble beach. Drift logs, kelp.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed site set up for RVs. Picnic tables. Pit toilets. Reservations accepted. The Mamalilikulla prefer this site not to be shown to the public for archaelogical reasons.
properties.Other Comments: Non-potable water at tap. Boat launch (high water only). Hiking trail to whale rubbing beach, viewing platform. Hydrophones. Regional Park of Mt Waddington Regional District. See Bere Point Regional Park

properties.Title: Graeme Point north
properties.Landing Comments: Cobble beach. Exposed. Fairly steep. Kelp.
properties.Camp Comments: Many possibilities along beach berm.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Graeme Point
properties.Landing Comments: Cobble beach. Exposed. Fairly steep. Kelp.
properties.Camp Comments: Many possibilities along beach.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Penn Islands central
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on rough boulder beach with low to medium slope, reefs. Pebble, smaller 10-20 cm angular cobble in broad band with oysters at lower water. Larger 20-30 cm angular cobble at high water. W aspect. Exposed to W, S
properties.Camp Comments: 2 upland sites at centre bay if brushed. w possible upper beach sites at neaps. NE side has further potential. 1-2 additional sites possible with second beach access. Small sites on mossy rock bluffs.
properties.Other Comments: View. Old cabin, garbage present (2023).

properties.Title: Waiatt Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on low gradient pebble, shell clam bed beach. Cobble at high water. Sheltered. Long carry at low water,
properties.Camp Comments: Some camping use. Small forest clearing. Undeveloped user-maintained wilderness site.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. Attractive. Trail to lake. Heavy day use. Staging for portage to Small Inlet. View. Beach fires are banned all year round. See Small Inlet Marine Park.

properties.Title: Shark Spit
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand, pebble. SE side preferred as conditions permit. Long carry at low water, especially from NW side. Currents.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped beach site tides permitting or grassy upland in trees. Pit toilet. No fires. Camp furniture. 2 picnic tables. When occupied, some paddlers have camped further S on same shore, also nearer to W shore.
properties.Other Comments: Camping by paddlers tolerated by generous landowner to date (2024). Significant local use. Please make every effort to camp responsibly adhering to Code of Conduct.

properties.Title: We Wai Kai
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on low gradient protected pebble beach. Long carry at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed commercial campground. Waterfront serviced sites for RVs etc. Toilets, showers, water at taps. Office, further sites across road from beach.
properties.Other Comments: Adjacent to Rebecca Spit Provincial Park. Trails, other nearby facilities. See We Wai Kai Campsite. Owned and operated by the Cape Mudge Indian Band (We Wai Kai Nation). Fees charged. Beach fires are banned all year round.

properties.Title: Mels Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, on protected moderate gradient cobble, pebble beach in protected bay. N aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Gloomy, damp but spacious. 1 tent site in upland second growth forest. Second site requires brushing. 2 or 3 additional sites overgrown (2021). Minor brushing could yield more tent sites. Larger sites on E side. Possible beach camping. Suited to hammocks. Sites littered with debris. Many trees reported to be rotten so camping could be hazardous in windy conditions.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Hiking trails crossed island but reported to be impasable. Whale watching. Bay known as Dong Chong Bay. One of the 4 sites on Hanson I sanctioned by Yukusam Heritage Society for public use. Logging relics. Messy with abandoned boat gear that was to be removed by YHS/Namgis 2014 but still present 2021.

properties.Title: Potts Lagoon
properties.Landing Comments: Easy in sheltered bay except at low water. Rocks at high water, sand, mud at low.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland forest site. Access up steep bank with rope to assist on E side of bay. Alternate access via rocks 20 m to N. Fire ring.
properties.Other Comments: Ecologically interesting. Anchorage.

properties.Title: Paddlers Inn Broughton Archipelago
properties.Landing Comments: Low floats.
properties.Camp Comments: No camping but several opportunities nearby. Float house self catering lodge, small cabin and shore sited cabin available for rent. Shower, flush toilet.
properties.Other Comments: The main goal of the Paddlers Inn is to provide their clients with the beauty of the BC coastline combined with comfortable, safe experiences. Mostly easy and interesting paddling, comparatively safe for beginners. Phone: 250-230-0088 or e-mail: info@paddlersinn.ca or website: Paddlers Inn.

properties.Title: Hot Springs Cove - ʔupnit
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered inlet. Easy at high water at cleared boat run among boulders. Moderate at low water on steep boulder, cobble beach. Boat, float plane traffic. Optional landing near public dock.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed campsite with very small rough sites. Tent sites are long walk from public / park dock, beach where some paddlers might prefer to land. Shelter, picnic table. Rough pit toilet, likely unusable. No fires. Fee charged. Site operator suggests using composting toilets in adjacent Provincial Park. Site operator will bring water from village in jugs but only on request. Subject also to Ahousaht Stewardship Fee.
properties.Other Comments: Access fee requested $15 per person for accessing the hot springs along boardwalk. 2 km walk from dock to Hot Springs. Water is available at the adjacent provincial park. Hot springs open to general public from dawn to dusk but permitted commercial operators may only bring guests in 11 am-5 pm. Some hours reserved for Nuu-chah-nulth visits only.

properties.Title: Yuquot
properties.Landing Comments: Easy landing on sand, gravel beach S of large dock. Yuquot Heritage site landing fee.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed commercial campground in mowed field and cabin accommodation nearby. Paddlers may camp on upland beside beach. Landing and camping fees. Toilets. Yuquot Camping Rental
properties.Other Comments: Tiny community. Trailhead for Nootka Trail. Other small trails in vicinity. Historic site. Summer freighter service from Gold River, Tahsis. Anchorage - Provincial Boat Haven. Museum in former church. Lighthouse may be visited. Aka Friendly Cove

properties.Title: San Josef Heritage Park
properties.Landing Comments: Steep gravel launch in river maintained by BC Parks.  Advisable to paddle river at high tide. Low water impedes 3 NM channel, can give high surf at river mouth.
properties.Camp Comments: NB. Road closure for bridge replacement Sept 2018. Developed. San Josef Heritage Park Campground. Pit toilets, fire pits, picnic tables. Ph. 250-288-3682. Reported (7-2024) The commercial campground near the boat launch has been abandoned and doesn't appear to be a safe place to leave a car anymore.
properties.Other Comments: Water, but not potable. Safe overnight vehicle parking. Fees charged.

properties.Title: Middle Copeland Nuxwum
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on 2 beaches of gravel, cobble with either NE or SW aspects at opposite ends of small island. Preferred landing is at N tip. S landing has little or no area for boat storage ashore. Vessel traffic in Thulin Passage.
properties.Camp Comments: 10 tent pads. Vault toilet in centre. Picnic area, table at N end. No fires. Exposed to W. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive, view. Aka Weed Island. View. See Copeland Islands Marine Park

properties.Title: West Curme Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy in central cove at mid or high water. Small beach or rock shelf. Awkward at low water. Narrow channel dries. Reefs. Also in small bay on NE side at all tides.
properties.Camp Comments: 9 wooden raised tent platforms on treed rock ledges, bluffs on W side. Vault toilet. Picnic area. No fires. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. E and W islands connect at mid, low water. See Desolation Sound Marine Provincial ParkPark Operator: 1312768 BC Ltd email DesolationSound.Camping@outlook.com

properties.Title: Pig Ranch north
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on low gradient firm clam bed beach with cobble, pebble surface in protected bay. No beach at high water. Drift logs.
properties.Camp Comments: Semi-exposed, unattractive 2 sites in trees. Camping on point to S not permitted. Occasional use by commercial groups.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Views. See Qwiquallaaq/Boat Bay Conservancy.

properties.Title: Broken Islands Havannah Channel
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, rough pebble/cobble beaches, reefs, kelp, sheltered cove NE side of largest island.
properties.Camp Comments: Semi-developed camp in forest or small rough beach sites between logs. Beach on NW side might offer another option depending on number of drift logs. Not used often. Windthrown trees might block some tent sites and/or create hazards for camping.
properties.Other Comments: Views, wildlife.

properties.Title: Kaikash Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, on firm gravel, pebble/cobble. At low water avoid larger rocks at centre beach. Vessel traffic, exposed.
properties.Camp Comments: Extensive site along old road. Composting toilet. Site needs some maintenance (2022). Picnic tables in disrepair. Adjacent commercial site has irregular tent platforms, other structures but is not part of public site.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. View. Whale watching information sign. Good wind protection. Site maintained by Namgis First Nation. Adjacent site receives heavy use by guided groups.

properties.Title: Naka Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on gravel, pebble beach. Exposed. See Naka Creek hand launch.
properties.Camp Comments: Semi exposed developed site. Pit toilet. Picnic tables. At least one party camped on breakwater at N50D 28.733M,W 126D 25.19M (WGS84).
properties.Other Comments: Water from culvert above the rec site - use at own risk. Road access via Eve Main and Naka Main but could be rough. Eve Main is active logging road, use mobile radio (June 2025). Parking. View. Boat launch. Caretaker occasionally. No fee charged but some paddlers have been asked to pay. Robson Bight whale rubbing beach, is over 5km away AND is closed to all entry. Not even kayakers may enter the bay.

properties.Title: Nichols Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Deep bay with steep pebble, gravel beaches. SE aspect. Many piled drift logs make landing difficult at mid, high water.  Beach normally floods. Well protected from W. Open to SE swell. Wash from N bound ships comes ashore. Reporter in 2024 considered high water landing too dangerous to attempt due to drift log pileup.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Small areas of beach gravel give access to small cleared upland forest site on NE of bay. Minor brushing may be needed. Clearcut behind. Beach sites might be possible at Neaps, avoiding carry over drift logs, deadfall.
properties.Other Comments: Usable for NW conditions at low water but marginal.

properties.Title: Waterfall Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on pebble beach, exposed to NW. Some shelter in creek mouth.
properties.Camp Comments: Hazardous. Upland forest site 50 m S of creek in front of small cliff had rockfall 2021 May 2023 report of difficult access, also fallen tree at waterfall, At Neaps potential beach camp next to drift logs.
properties.Other Comments: Water at small falls, likely year-round. View.

properties.Title: Walkem Point
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient silty clam bed at low water. Cobble, scattered boulders, pebble at high water. Existing boat runs in need of maintenance. Various other pebble beaches along shores to E.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach sites feasible at tides below 4.1 m. Extensive open third growth forest, thinned some years ago. Several level areas. Big spruce tree at main beach site, upland access.
properties.Other Comments: Water at braided seasonal creek crosses centre beach. View. Aka North of Walkem Islands.

properties.Title: Sonora Island southwest
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on low gradient gravel, cobble beach in shallow bay. Riprap breakwater protects N side. Exposed SW aspect. 50 m carry at low water. Currents offshore. Ship wash. Prominent rock pile at entrance.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped, sheltered large inactive log dump. Grass, broom.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek, possibly year-round. View. Inactive log handling reserve. Old orchard, cabin. Aka Discovery Mountain Cove.

properties.Title: Florence Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand, mud, pebble beach with some larger rocks. S aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Small upland grassy site about 15 m up from beach or sites on beach except during Springs. Potential for more sites. Sheltered. SW aspect. Somewhat damp. Could be buggy.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Report of year-round water at creek 200-300 m to N around point suitable for boat access. Staging for local channels. Some fish farm and other debris. Possibly a former or inactive log dump.

properties.Title: Little Bear Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, gravel/pebble/cobble, exposed, vessel traffic, currents, wind. Land at river mouth between camp sites..
properties.Camp Comments: Developed. Picnic tables. Heavy RV use. pit toilet, picnic tables, fire rings. Maintained.Nearby fish hatchery runs audible generator at all times.
properties.Other Comments: Water at nearby creek. View Parking limited if not camping. See also launch site details. .

properties.Title: Octopus west shore
properties.Landing Comments: Beach inside S facing point. Easy on low gradient mud, pebble, clam bed beach adjacent to bedrock outcrops. SW aspect. Sheltered from most winds.
properties.Camp Comments: Grassy upland sites on two lightly forested levels. Undeveloped user maintained wilderness site. Site was previously suggested 190 m SW across bay at muddier, lower gradient shore.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek 100 m to W in corner of bay. Attractive. View. Beach fires are banned all year round. See Octopus Islands Marine Park.

properties.Title: South Rendezvous Island south
properties.Landing Comments: Awkward in protected cove N of islet. Some rubble, gravel, pebble. Boulders at high water. All-weather protection. Boat run cleared of larger boulders. Boat may be lined out to W. Alternate approach to S of islet also has boat run but rougher except at tides below 1 m when N side shows awkward concrete retaining wall.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp in sloping protected grassy meadow. Clear tent sites, some shaded. Open air pit toilet no longer serviceable (2024). Undeveloped user maintained wilderness camping. One tent site on islet. Hazardous tree snag noted 2024.
properties.Other Comments: Possible but unreliable water at seasonal creek. Former homestead. Pilings of old boathouse. Attractive. Staging area for tidal rapids. See Rendezvous Island South Provincial Park

properties.Title: Waiatt Bay south
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on mud, pebble.
properties.Camp Comments: At least one upland sloped dry site on duff above bank. Others on lower grassy wet areas that might flood at Springs. Potential for more sites. May be better tent sites slightly to W. Undeveloped user-maintained wilderness site.
properties.Other Comments: Largest island to NE is recently acquired (2019) for Park. Has frequently visited old cabin full of memorabilia left by visitors. Beach fires are banned all year round. See Octopus Islands Marine Park.

properties.Title: Waiatt Bay islet
properties.Landing Comments: Awkward on bedrock ledges. Easy on gravel at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Open grassy bluffs at S end.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Beach fires are banned all year round. See Octopus Islands Marine Park.

properties.Title: Freedom Point
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on beach of sharp angular cobble, pebble, rubble. Approach from S. Boat run cleared through larger rocks. S aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Large semi-developed site on point, could use more leveling. Other dispersed tent sites. Composting toilet along trail to NE away from shoreline. Warning: June 2025 hazardous tree along path to rear tent sites- caution.
properties.Other Comments: Water at small seasonal creek. Staging for Surge Narrows. Occasionally used by large groups. Aka Surge Point - so named on topo maps but Surge Pt proper lies to N.

properties.Title: Frederic Point
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on steep gravel, cobble, rubble, rock beach. Small rocks at low water. Boulders to 600 mm at high water. Fish farm metal barrier hard to see. Landing at point feasible only in calm conditions. Otherwise cove to W is better with moderately long gear carry.  SW to NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Rough tent sites with minor brushing. Potential for more sites. Mossy bedrock bluffs.
properties.Other Comments: View. Attractive, sensitive natural area. Wildflowers. Inactive shellfish lease. but debris remains from it.

properties.Title: Whale Passage
properties.Landing Comments: Approach from S. Rough rock-strewn entrance lip to small gravel basin at high water. Awkward with kelp, weed at low water. Boats arriving at low water could be tied nearby until basin floods to give easier access or face long carry. Advisable to land at mid-high water. SW aspect. Exposed to S.
properties.Camp Comments: Small fairly level upland bluff sites in 2 areas on peninsula among arbutus, firs. Some tent sites overlook passage to E. One panoramic site on open mossy bluff has active eagle nest May 2018, 2019. Stay 100 m away Mar to Aug. Site to S with possible easier access off separate beach short distance to S.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Oyster lease at foreshore inactive but some debris remains (2024).

properties.Title: Penn Islands southwest
properties.Landing Comments: Mixed exposed beach of varying gradient. Easy at high water on tides of 4 m or greater on gravel, pebble medium gradient with small boat run.  Awkward to difficult at all lower water levels on steep beach of boulders, smaller mixed rocks, Boulders to sides, reefs in W approach. S aspect. Could be hazardous in S wind, swell. Report in 2024 of blowdown trees in landing area.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. 1 good site on mossy W bluff, 2 other feasible with brushing but sloped or lumpy. 1 or 2 beach sites if levelled, but might flood at Springs. Be aware of hazardous tree reported at W bluff and other blowdowns.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Wildlife viewing.

properties.Title: Bay south of Von Donop
properties.Landing Comments: Long low gradient beach on mixed rocks. NW aspect. Reported at N50.171283D, W-124.986667D outside bay proper, but more likely location is N50.170864D, W124.986805D nearer to bay head.
properties.Camp Comments: Marginal sites at beach top or upland in sloping forest. Levelling, brushing likely needed. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Aquaculture in bay to N.

properties.Title: Von Donop Inlet
properties.Landing Comments: Boat run offers clear path through boulders on small steep beach. Easier access at high water. All weather protection. Tidal currents. Vessel traffic to anchorage.
properties.Camp Comments: Large semi-developed user-maintained site. Some cleared sites on grassy headland. Beware of hazard trees. Fire pit.
properties.Other Comments: Trails, reversing tidal rapids, lagoon nearby. Anchorage. Historic portage to Squirrel Cove. See Ha'thayim (Von Donop) Marine Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Little Hanson Island
properties.Landing Comments: Moderately difficult rock, rubble - shelf between two northerly islands in sheltered channel between Hanson Island and Little Hanson. Usable at mid, high water levels. Landing, launching at water levels below 1.5 m not recommended. Signs of a narrow boat run. Strong currents, rough water in Blackney Passage. Vessel traffic.
properties.Camp Comments: Semi exposed, part developed. Tent sites on exposed rock, or on soil among trees. Sites strung along trail around S end of island also on smaller island to S.
properties.Other Comments: Views. Aka Island 61 or Blackney Passage Island. One of the only 4 sites on Hanson I that are sanctioned by Yukusam Heritage Society for public use.

properties.Title: Blinkhorn Peninsula
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on pebble, cobble beach sheltered by peninsula. Land either side. NE side cobbles, some boulders at high water. SE side small smooth pebbles. Vessel traffic.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered forest upland camping in 3 locations or on large beach. Picnic table. Composting toilet. Site maintained through contract with Namgis First Nation. Number of sites reported as 9 in 2025. See SCR297 for camp location details.
properties.Other Comments: Seasonal creek. Whale viewing. Anchorage. Historic hiking trail to Telegraph Cove. Hiking trail across islet to navigational marker.

properties.Title: Growler Cove northwest
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on rock, pebble beach at head of prominent protected bay. Many boulders, bedrock outcrops at low water. Cobble, small angular rocks above. Evidence of boat run at centre beach. Gradient moderate to steep. SE aspect. Protected from NW. Rocks offshore.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered, undeveloped. Tent sites in open forest along flagged trail or on beach, tides permitting. Additional sites if brushed. Hammock opportunities. Fire pit.
properties.Other Comments: Views. Occasional use by commercial groups. See Qwiquallaaq/Boat Bay Conservancy.

properties.Title: Little Blenkinsop Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, on white sand. Low gradient. Dries a long distance.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on beach or in forest clearings. JK guide has camp at 50 28.95N 126 01.64W. Some sites are adjacent to logged area further from creek.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. Aka West Blenkinsop Cove on Cruising Planner map.

properties.Title: Pine Point
properties.Landing Comments: Exposed beach of pebble, cobble. NE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: On E side of point, camping unknown. Likely in upland, needing much brushing. Previous to 2022 site was at now-commercial site on W side of point run by Grey Wolf Expeditions. Might have space for limited number of public visitors in sheltered undeveloped clearing behind trees, reported to be overgrown 2021 but cleared more recently. Pit toilet reported to be unusable but likely repaired. Some trees reported to be hazardous.
