properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal or year-round substantial creek. View.

properties.Title: Camp Point
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on low gradient, broad, pebble, gravel beach. Exposed to NW. Current hazards, turbulence. Vessel traffic.
properties.Camp Comments: Large undeveloped site.
properties.Other Comments: Road access in past. Aka Prince of Wales Bay. Large 33 Ha. site.

properties.Title: Turn Bay west
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on broad low gradient sheltered mixed beach of pebble, cobble. Mostly floods at high water. S aspect. Protected by island, islet.
properties.Camp Comments: Small upland sloped forest sites will need minor brushing. One possible beach top site seems dry at all tides. Hammock opportunities. Potential for many sites.
properties.Other Comments: Seasonal creek at site. View.

properties.Title: Frances Bay head
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on low gradient boulder, cobble, pebble beach, exposed to SE. May be long carry.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped in upland forest. Dense vegetation at water's edge makes access awkward.
properties.Other Comments: Water at 2 creeks - at head of bay or in Raza Passage. View. Temporary logging float camp 2013-2014. Anchorage.

properties.Title: Raza Point
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on steep cobble, boulder beach in protected cove. Boat run clear of boulders. NE aspect. Rougher landing at S aspect beach also within Recreation Reserve.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Small gloomy cleared upland forest sites, reported as needing brushing, levelling 2021 & 2022. Hammock opportunities. Well sheltered.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Trail between bays. Peninsula 16 ha area is all Recreation Reserve incl S beach. Some industrial debris.

properties.Title: Shipwreck Bluff
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered coves on either side of promontory. Easy silty, muddy clam bed on W side. Easier but longer carry at low water. Cobbles, rock, sand in E cove. Hazardous derelict dock tied up in W bay (June 2025).
properties.Camp Comments: Semi-developed in small clearings in 2 upland areas - at promontory neck or in forest behind boat wreck along short trail.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Staging for local channels. Old roadbed beyond wreck reported hazardous in places. Lake 500 m N on road network.

properties.Title: North Rendezvous Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, shell beach at high tide, moderate, many boulders at low tide. On a small islet joined by rocky tombolo to NW of N Rendezvous Island. Boats may be lined out to W of cobble tombolo.
properties.Camp Comments: 4 site in upland in trees on islet plus room for 1 small tent. Fire pit. 25 m carry at low water. Sites brushed out 2025. Additional site in trees on larger N Rendezvous facing across tombolo on S shore - see site plan. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: View. Aka North Rendezvous Islet. Most of N Rendezvous Island is private land. Strathcona Regional District mapping shows adjacent lot of 4.14 ha as Regional Park - Rendezvous Park, so not private.

properties.Title: Whiterock Passage
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient tombolo clam bed of gravel, mud, sand connects to isthmus. Shoals. Approach from SW or from N. Long carry at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Upland sites in old growth forest approx. 80 m S or SE of tombolo. Additional exposed small sites on dry, grassy area or on rocky isthmus.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek 100 m to SE of forest camp. View. Cabin ruins not seen 2024. Inactive shellfish lease (2009, 2018). Debris remains 2018. Was active 2004. Land nearby to S appears to be private.

properties.Title: South Rendezvous Island north
properties.Landing Comments: Gravel, pebble at low water. Moderate with some boulders at higher water. Between headlands. Can launch from rocks. Exposed to N. Reported in Aug 2021 landing (low tide) and launching (high tide) challenging. Rocks at centre beach are hard to carry a boat over. Numerous logs limit launch area at high water. Ramp cleared north of islet.
properties.Camp Comments: Attractive cleared sites on headland E of beach. Undeveloped user maintained wilderness site. Please pay attention to good sanitation practices.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Views. Staging area for tidal rapids. Entire island is park. See Rendezvous Island South Provincial Park. Toilet appears to be repaired. Add dry leaves to it if no shavings.

properties.Title: Ashlar Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, on pebble, cobble beach at all water levels. Larger rocks, mostly rounded, at low water. W aspect. Some protection from NW.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Large clearing in small trees. Suitable for groups.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round creek. View. Hiking trail leads inland from clearing to unknown destination. Beach fires are banned all year round.

properties.Title: Discovery Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on pebble, cobble beach depending on tide level. Exposed to SE, NE. Vessel traffic. Broad fan offers several landing locations including creek mouth.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Protected from wind.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round creek.

properties.Title: Penn Islands north
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on mixed gravel beach, some reefs. Lies in hook of land protected from most directions. S aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Three sites on grass, bedrock shelf on bluff with trail access. Short crude stair on trail. Three additional sites above landing, in open forest. Composting toilet. Hammock opportunities. Avoid camping near dead tree on bluff especially in high winds. Make no upland fires. Nearby islet to S offers 1 overflow tent site.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. View. Attractive, secluded site. Many other sites among these islands. Frequent use by large guided groups. Alert: The BCMT recently cleaned the site in mid-July but apparently a squatter is on site and has left a mess there. We will try and clean the site in late August or September.

properties.Title: Carrington Point
properties.Landing Comments: 2 small boat runs through rubble beach next to cliff. Beach mostly floods at high water. Moderate gradient. Inside islet with good protection. W aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Clear tent sites in open forest. Marine debris makes access difficult.
properties.Other Comments: View. Attractive. Trickle of water at seasonal creek. Poorer beach 200 m to NW. Likely possible to use sites behind that other beach via small trail. Carrington Bay Park, Strathcona Regional District.

properties.Title: Maud Island Discovery Passage
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on moderate gradient pebble, cobble beach, or on steeper causeway riprap in protected bay. SE aspect. Currents outside bay. Private float nearby. Difficult access from W.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Camping on Quadra shore adjacent to causeway on W or E side. Some shelter from NW, but wind may funnel. E side offers more protection. Possible alternative site at N 50D 7.923M,W 125D 20.278M not assessed.
properties.Other Comments: Near former Ripple Rock. Access hiking trail maintained by RSTBC. Anchorage. Reported small tidal electric generating plant in causeway to island but nothing visible 2018. Aquaculture nearby in S bay. Purpose and ownership of float and gangway unknown - presumably energy company property. Saltwater lagoon nearby. Beach fires are banned all year round.

properties.Title: Twin Islands Islet
properties.Landing Comments: Rough oyster beaches of pebble, boulders, bedrock. One beach in small cove on NW side, another in small cove on SW or facing Twin Islands. Mostly protected but some landing sites exposed. Easier landing at high water. Avoid low. mid water levels - reported as hazardous  - oysters. Avoid use in Spring nesting season to protect resident Black Oystercatchers (shore birds).
properties.Camp Comments: Upland clear areas on centre to W side 50 m from S side cove.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Small trails across islet. Larger islands are private.

properties.Title: Port Desire
properties.Landing Comments: See Grappler Inlet launch site.
properties.Camp Comments: Small developed campground. Open grassed areas may lack privacy. Toilets, food bins, picnic area, playground, pay showers RV or boat pump-out station. Water at hoses. Gazebos, BBQ grills. Call 250 728-3006. Information Centre staffed through summer season. Pay phone available year round. Fee $26.50/night (2022). Email communityparks@mybamfield.ca
properties.Other Comments: Close to village, amenities. Boat launch. Eileen Scott Centennial Park, 345 Grappler Rd, Bamfield. Parking $5/ day (2022).

properties.Title: Anderson Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Protected cove. Inner rough beaches of cobble, rubble. Rock shelves at low water. S aspect.  Also smoother, easier beach moderate gradient on outer side of isthmus, N aspect. Cobble upper beach, gravel lower.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped on isthmus of peninsula. Fire pits. Small clearings in open forest. Low salal undergrowth.
properties.Other Comments: View. Provincial Boat Haven. Inactive log dump on W bay shore. Head of bay is outside Park, has crown lease upland, low gradient silt beach, mudflats, flotsam at low water. Also reported as having public road access to or near shoreline. Island immediately to S has rough landing beach on N side for possible picnic site. See Anderson Bay Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Mackenzie Anchorage
properties.Land Tenure: Crown, Crown tenure - Section 17 designated use area
properties.Landing Comments: No comments.
properties.Camp Comments: Site might be up to 80m to N of indicated position.
properties.Other Comments: Huu-ay-aht Treaty Settlement Land. Permit required

properties.Title: Clarke Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected sand, shell beach that extends on both W, E sides of small point. Moderate gradient. Some rock outcrops.
properties.Camp Comments: Open meadow. Camp among trees. Composting toilet. See: Brochure..Required 1) National Park Entry Pass if age 18 or older; 2) Backcountry Camping Permit $9.80 per person/night; 3) Site reservation. No standbys!; See: National Park PermitSee: Camping Permits & Reservations or 1-877-RESERVE
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Maximum stay 4 nights. Maximum group size 12. Several sandy lagoons on island.

properties.Title: Dodd Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sheltered pebble beach of moderate gradient in natural harbour. S aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp in forest clearings. Composting toilet. Beach on south side better. N Beach only ok at high tide, has rock shelf at mid and lower tides. See: Brochure..Required 1) National Park Entry Pass if age 18 or older; 2) Backcountry Camping Permit $9.80 per person/night; 3) Site reservation. No standbys!; See: National Park Permit. See: Camping Permits & Reservations or 1-877-RESERVE
properties.Other Comments: Historic fish traps in adjacent bay. Maximum stay 4 nights. Maximum group size 12.

properties.Title: Turret Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected shell, sand beach at NW end of Turret I. S aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered sites under giant spruce. Composting toilet. See: Brochure.. Required 1) National Park Entry Pass if age 18 or older; 2) Backcountry Camping Permit $9.80 per person/night; 3) Site reservation. No standbys! See: National Park Permit. See: Camping Permits & Reservations or 1-877-RESERVE.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Maximum stay 4 nights. Maximum group size 12. Visible midden. Very large trees.

properties.Title: Hand Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected tombolo shell beaches. Aspects SE or NW. Reefs offshore.
properties.Camp Comments: Open, grassy area. Composting toilet. See: Brochure.. Required 1) National Park Entry Pass if age 18 or older; 2) Backcountry Camping Permit $9.80 per person/night; 3) Site reservation. No standbys! See: National Park Permit. See: Camping Permits & Reservations or 1-877-RESERVE.
properties.Other Comments: Maximum stay 4 nights. Maximum group size 12. Closest of Broken Group islands to Secret Beach popular launch site.

properties.Title: Gibraltar Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand, gravel beach.
properties.Camp Comments: Campsite exposed to Imperial Eagle Channel. Composting toilet. See: Brochure. Required 1) National Park Entry Pass if age 18 or older; 2) Backcountry Camping Permit $9.80 per person/night; 3) Site reservation. No standbys! See: National Park Permit. See: Camping Permits & Reservations or 1-877-RESERVE
properties.Other Comments: Views. Maximum stay 4 nights. Maximum group size 12. Toilet is in poor condition probably because of over use in popular and crowded site

properties.Title: Long Bay Jedediah Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on firm mud beach in protected bay at mid-high water i.e. approx. 2.0 m or higher but drying mud flat at low water. Tides above 4 m leave no foreshore. Boats must be carried up grass slope if not left at anchor to settle in mud. Alternative landings in coves to W on Bull Passage - Sunset, Otter Coves.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on roomy grass bank. Unofficial capacity very high. Pit toilet. Optional approach from adjacent Otter, Sunset Coves avoiding low water mud flat, but camping discouraged In those coves because of distance to toilet. Camping fees apply 15 May to 15 September. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2019) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. 3.5 km of hiking trails. See Jedediah Island Provincial Marine Park

properties.Title: Gilbert Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected sand, gravel beach with some rubble. NE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered site in open forest. Composting toilet. See: Brochure.. Required 1) National Park Entry Pass if age 18 or older..2) Backcountry Camping Permit $9.80 per person/night..3) Site reservation. No standbys! See: National Park Permit...See: Camping Permits & Reservations or 1-877-RESERVE
properties.Other Comments: Maximum stay 4 nights. Maximum group size 12. Water source on Effingham I.

properties.Title: Escalante River
properties.Landing Comments:
Easy to difficult access to river depending on swell height. Rocks exposed at low tides.
Can have landing issues due to surf, but if you go past rocks at Escalante point north there is a small cove that is sheltered.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on upland, or on sand at S bank of river mouth. Exposed. Lots of area to set up tents on sand by the river. Water was running very well in June, very clean, and a couple of spots to swim in. Beautiful beach that runs into Escalante north where there are more camp sites on sand also trail starts here to Escalante south look for buoy in tree for start.
properties.Other Comments: Water upstream in river. Brackish at mouth. Attractive. View. Huge Recreation Site 111 Ha area runs S to Escalante Point N.

properties.Title: Crib Island
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient beach of mud, sand with many small boulders at low water.  S aspect. Protected. Long carry at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on high bench in trees behind large boulder on beach. Beach sites possible at Neaps but beach floods at Springs.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek to W of tent sites. Attractive. Aka Sunday Harbour. See Broughton Archipelago Provincial Park

properties.Title: Pearl Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy landing on protected beach. Low gradient clam bed of mud at low water. Mixed boulder, cobble, rubble beach of moderate gradient at high water. Weed-covered boulders at low water are best avoided by attention to timing. Evidence of old boat run.
properties.Camp Comments: Some tent sites might require brushing. Not used much. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: See Broughton Archipelago Provincial Park

properties.Title: Laura Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Sloping bedrock shelves In sheltered cove. Some sand. Numerous boulders make carrying gear hazardous.
properties.Camp Comments: Sites In trees on N side of cove head. One view site overlooks sea.
properties.Other Comments: Popular anchorage. Provincial Boat Haven, hence less privacy than many other sites. Passage at Trivett Island navigable by paddlecraft at high water. Seldom used by paddlers.

properties.Title: John Island northwest
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered shell, sand, mud beach NW aspect. Reported 2025 that site coordinates may be wrong. Suggest looking at beach 250 metres to SW.
properties.Camp Comments: Access up moderately steep bank via overgrown trail to upland sites, needing brushing mostly of dense salal.
properties.Other Comments: Spring tides may leave little room for boat storage. See Broughton Archipelago Park.

properties.Title: Battle Bay
properties.Land Tenure: Treaty Settlement Land designated for public access
properties.Landing Comments: Easy all tide landing on wide sand beach. Some surf on W side.
properties.Camp Comments: Many beach sites or 5 cleared, flat tent sites in trees. One site is large enough for 2 tents. Note that no camping is permitted at nearby Battle River and Acous Peninsula which are in private Treaty Settlement Lands.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round creek at E corner. Hose makes water collection easy. Pool for bathing but maybe seasonal. Attractive, View. Anchorage - Provincial Boat Haven. Formerly part of Mquqwin Brooks Peninsula Provincial Park, now public access Treaty Settlement Land under the Maa_nulth Treaty. Park boundary nearby to E.

properties.Title: Lord Waterfall
properties.Landing Comments: Easy. on small pebble, cobble beach, with mostly boulders at high water. 150 m SE of creek.
properties.Camp Comments: Small headland and cleared patch above. Little shade. Old road bed provides further sites if elderberry brushed.
properties.Other Comments: Water at large year-round creek. Trail to creek. Waterfall, swim hole. View. Fish farm nearby.

properties.Title: Santiago Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Land N of creek by sign on beach of gravel, rock 2-10 cm, occasional boulders, protected from S. Other adjacent beaches of cobble. Channel winds can be strong but currents not a factor. Vessel traffic.
properties.Camp Comments: Site currently closed by RSTBC. Danger trees in area and caution is warranted until removal. Many sites on clear grass area, also in forest behind. 2 picnic tables in disrepair; one useable. Pit toilet in good condition (2025). Site maintenance needed. Fire pits.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. Former dock removed, so site unlikely to be used by power boaters in future. Sunny, but somewhat buggy.

properties.Title: Saltery Bay Esperanza Inlet
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected shallow gradient alluvial fan beach of mixed gravel, cobble.
properties.Camp Comments: One site at top of beach. Several sites accessed via rocky creek beds in upland forest. Large area, but rough, bushy. Brushing likely needed. Likely to be damp in wet weather.
properties.Other Comments: Water at small creek. Strategic location.

properties.Title: Stud Islets
properties.Landing Comments: Steep white shell, sand beach, SW aspect. SW aspect. May be subject to dumping waves but islet in front offers some protection.
properties.Camp Comments: Pleasant upland for at least4 campsites. Beach sites at most tides. Rustic kitchen area. Poorly placed fire pit.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Well-used by paddlers, fishers.

properties.Title: Tsusiat Falls
properties.Landing Comments: Exposed. Surf likely. Bedrock shelves.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach site heavily used by hikers. Composting toilet. Food storage bins.
properties.Other Comments: Prominent waterfall. Landing or camping on the West Coast Trail is not permitted and could result in fines, except in emergency situations.

properties.Title: Thrasher Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered sand beach.
properties.Camp Comments: Arrive early for best site. Toilet.
properties.Other Comments: Desirable designated stop, strategically located for paddlers. Also located near end of West Coast hiking Trail. Landing or camping on the West Coast Trail is not permitted and could result in fines, except in emergency situations.

properties.Title: Sombrio Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Popular surfing beach. Might be difficult for canoe, kayak landings in heavy surf conditions. River mouth gives easier landing opportunity. Steep in places. Mixed cobble, sand.
properties.Camp Comments: Camping permitted beach camping pads at W end. Bear cache. Pit toilet. Camping fees apply year-round. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $10.00 per adult per night (2018) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
properties.Other Comments: Well used by hikers. On JDF hiking trail. 1-2 km to trailhead vehicle access. 500 m carry to beach from trailhead. See: Juan de Fuca Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Mystic Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Exposed. Expect some surf. Beach mostly of sand.
properties.Camp Comments: 10 platforms added 2023/24. 2 food bins. Small sites at top of beach. Pit toilet. Camping fees apply year-round. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $10.00 per adult per night (2018) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
properties.Other Comments: Hiker use. On JDF hiking trail. 2 km to trailhead vehicle access, lots of day hikers, campers especially at summer weekends. See: Juan de Fuca Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Jordan River
properties.Landing Comments: Cobble, pebble beach. Land in river mouth near bridge on E bank. Beware of pilings. See image for best approach. Surf somewhat likely.
properties.Camp Comments: 4 pit or vault toilets. Year-round campground. Walk-in sites with tent pads, RV sites. Fire rings. Unofficial sites may serve as overflow.. No reservations - first come, first served. Fees charged via drop box.
properties.Other Comments: Limited water at drinking station. Vehicle access. View. Adjacent to highway. 3.5 km cobble beach. Hiking trails. Jordan River Regional Park, 187 ha. Capital Regional District. See: Jordan River Regional Park.

properties.Title: French Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Subject to moderate surf. Cobble, steep in places.
properties.Camp Comments: No beach camping permitted. Developed sites 500m from beach but group site is closer. Pit toilets, picnic tables.
properties.Other Comments: Water at tap. 5 min trail to campsite. Vehicle access - gated for group site closer to beach. French Beach

properties.Title: Jervis Island
properties.Landing Comments: Protected bay inside Bunny Island on W side. Beach of gravel, shell. W aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland sites in treed grove above beach. Rustic wooden stairs lead up moderately steep bank. Rustic outhouse in need of maintenance.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Former homestead with built water catchment basins, now defunct. Some trails reported to lead across island. Anchorage. See Sabine Channel Marine Provincial Park

properties.Title: Nelson Beach west
properties.Landing Comments: Cobble beach with some boulders. Some protection from NW. Access could be difficult at high water. Beach probably floods.
properties.Camp Comments: Forest very dense behind beach but up rocks on E side is small level point with room for 3 or more tents in upland forest. Some brushing needed.
properties.Other Comments: Water at small creek. View.

properties.Title: Stimson Reef
properties.Landing Comments: Cobble beach with some boulders. S aspect. Reef gives some protection from NW.
properties.Camp Comments: A few upland forest sites with potential for many more.
properties.Other Comments: Water at small creek.

properties.Title: Steamboat Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered beach of small rocks, sand.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Protected site in trees, but gloomy, damp. Light brushing recommended. Hammock opportunities. Please remove upland fire ring hazard if visiting.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek.

properties.Title: Vere Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Sand, gravel, cobble low gradient beach in cove, open to W. Little beach at high water. Hazardous currents locally in Johnstone Strait.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland forest sites for approx 6 tents in NE corner of cove subject to brushing. Upland sites might have overgrown. Only 1 beach tent site found by 2022 reporter. Beach unreliable at Springs. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek.

properties.Title: Octopus Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Easy landing on rock ledges in protected bay on W of island.  Some low gradient grass, slimy mud. Sand at low water. Optional landing in rocky drying channel adjoining islet on S of island. Several other possible landing sites on shores of Park but specific information withheld at the request of local First Nation and BC Parks.
properties.Camp Comments: Good upland sites among trees on grass and rock, accessed by trail. Avoid trampling wild flowers, other vegetation. Undeveloped user maintained dispersed sites throughout Park.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View.. Note that several large islands are private. Beach fires are banned all year round. See Octopus Islands Marine Park.

properties.Title: East of Adam River
properties.Landing Comments: Wide cobble beach. NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Some brushing in second growth forest needed. Beach camp possible at neaps.
properties.Other Comments: No comments

properties.Title: Mount Milner
properties.Landing Comments: Moderately steep cobble, pebble beach. Currents. Landing has short vertical log on beach near high water, NW of main creek.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Semi-clear upland area on large level site among alders. Inactive log dump. Old roadways. Alternative beach sites on gravel at Neaps.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. Road access in past.

properties.Title: North Copeland Kwukwutays
properties.Landing Comments: Steep protected gravel beaches NW and SE of camp area for all tide levels except NW access beach dries extensively at lowest water levels -  long carry then required. Boulder-free boat run in NW bay.
properties.Camp Comments: 21 raised wooden tent pads in open forest or on points, some accessible from NW others from SE landings. Fence separate island. 2 composting toilets. Picnic area, table. No fires. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. See Copeland Islands Marine Park

properties.Title: Sarah Point
properties.Landing Comments: Exposed rough boulder beach in bay lies 250 m ESE of Sarah Pt site where map icon is displayed. SW aspect. Long carry to camp at position of icon. Some platforms might be accessible closer to landing beach. Hiker drop-off point used by water taxi unsuited to landing, unloading paddlecraft.
properties.Camp Comments: Landing beach is near mid-point between park ten platforms at Sarah Point and cabin at Sarah Point trailhead. 4 tent pads in upland 200 - 300 m WNW of landing beach accessed by trail up steep bluffs. Composting toilet also vault toilet at trail head. No fires. Also poor but possible beach camping. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites. Public cabin, toilet located at separate Recreation Site approx. 300 m to SSE of landing along trail.
properties.Other Comments: View, Site intended for hikers but not ideal for paddlers. At start of Sunshine Coast hiking Trail. View. Rough road access nearby to S from Bliss Landing 4 km. View. See Malaspina Provincial Park

properties.Title: Althorp Point
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand in cove. E aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland sites in dense forest with salal may need brushing. Protected from W.
properties.Other Comments: Clearcut behind beach. Fish farm in W cove. Occasional log storage in bay.

properties.Title: Smelt Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand, gravel, pebble beach. Sand shoal S of shoreline parking lot. Exposed to SW.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed campground in trees about 300 m from beach via trail. Pit toilets. Some picnic tables. Group site. Some reservable sites. Camping not permitted on grassed areas near beach.
properties.Other Comments: Water at taps. Trail. Boat ramp. See Smelt Bay Provincial Park

properties.Title: Poyntz Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy pebble upper beaches on both shores with larger rocks, boulders lower down. Choice of beaches facing NE or SW. Many drift logs on exposed SW facing beach, so beach with SE aspect usually preferred. 2024 report that access is blocked by a large fir tree lying across the entrance E. would be very hard to remove but it is possible to wade or carry boats by a small opening on the E side of the cove. Beaches flood at Springs.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped but comfortable site. Level headland has some clear areas, but mostly scrub, Few trees, thin soils.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Bird colonies. Rec res notation No. 6540 (283).

properties.Title: Carterer Point south
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate, cobble pebble, rubble. Near Wellbore Ch (Whirlpool) tidal rapids. No beach at high water. Protected except from SE.
properties.Camp Comments: Minor brushing may be needed. Upland only sites in second growth forest. Entire beach floods.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek, likely flows year-round. Just S of Whirlpool Rapids. Aka Wellbore Channel E.

properties.Title: Channe Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, protected cobble beach. E aspect. 100 m wide. Shallow gradient at high water. Steeper at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Potential for 1-3 more sites on level upland forest areas. One site currently (2017) blocked by fallen tree. Wild Coast Vol 3 suggests a site in next bay NW at N50 27.33, W125 19.92. A site with old cabin and some debris reported at N50 27.380, W125 19.978 with room 2 tents and beach space at most tides for at least one tent with some shifting around of minor flotsam. The cabin location might be the same as the previous one mentioned here.
properties.Other Comments: Quiet - fish farm noise inaudible.

properties.Title: Yorke Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected pebble beach among boulders in cove behind islets on S side of island. Beach at Courtenay Bay on E side of island may be preferred access, camp location but is hazardous because of barbed wire defences in undergrowth. Very rough, hazardous water conditions may occur near S and W shores of in strong wind, ebb tides.
properties.Camp Comments: Several unofficial sites on grass by shore or on trails further N. Loses sun early. Preferred camp location not yet established but likely near Courtenay Bay landing, possibly in 2019. Composting (mouldering) toilet at fort site. No camping near fort.
properties.Other Comments: Historic WW2 defensive gun position. Hiking trails. Maintained by Sayward Futures Society. Hazards include overgrown bunkers, wire, decaying buildings. Conservation work proceeding. See: Hənʎəmdzi Məkola/Yorke Island Conservancy.

properties.Title: Johns Point
properties.Landing Comments: Easy sand, pebble beach in sheltered bay. E aspect. Currents, turbulence off point. Alternative, rougher NW aspect beach on other side of neck.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on grass under alder trees on headland. Old picnic tables in haphazard arrangement, some stacked. Move tables to use additional tent sites.
properties.Other Comments: Debris from old saw mill. Mooring buoy. View.

properties.Title: Blair Islet Mackenzie Sound
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered sand, gravel beaches with some boulders either side of point. Little or no beach at high water.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Access up old trail by steep midden bank just W of S tip of islet. 2-3 level upland sites, others on slope could be brushed. 1 beach site at neaps. Thick salal, extensive deadfall, tree hazards reported, making most of the former approx 9 sites unusable without lots of work. Sunny, protected. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Marginal for small party but brushing, deadfall clearing needed for any additional tent sites.

properties.Title: Watson Point
properties.Landing Comments: Easy at all water levels on moderate gradient beach of gravel, shell, some 40-200 mm barnacled rocks S of sawmill ruins.  Prominent derelict dock visible (2021). Beach floods at at water levels above 4.8 m. Carry boats up to trail. Currents to N of site.
properties.Camp Comments: Short paths to upland. Choose steep one or awkward side hill with erosion issues. Picnic shelter, table. Sites on midden bank, in grassy area clearing behind ruined dock. Potential additional sites if brushed. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Water at small seasonal creek. Village site prior to sawmill site. Possible site for 1 tent in Windy Bay to S. Used occasionally by large commercial groups.

properties.Title: Shorter Point west
properties.Landing Comments: Beach of sand, cobble, rock. NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland sites W of creek. Small trees, deadfalls.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek.

properties.Title: Moore Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on dock with float. NW aspect. Rough, rocky adjacent beach landing to SE gives harder access on cobble, boulder, bedrock at all water levels. Sign visible from water.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed site in mature trees. 4 picnic tables, benches, pit toilets, fire pits, some tent platforms. Slightly gloomy.
properties.Other Comments: Small seasonal creek. Dock, float, anchorage. Rough landing if float not usable.17.8 Ha.

properties.Title: Atkinson South Islet
properties.Landing Comments: Access channel between Atkinson I, small islet to S. Cobble rock, boulder landing.  Strong currents. Channel may dry at low water. Other channel to S blocked by logs, stumps. Safest land approach over rough terrain from E side.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped small marginal site in salal. Potential for more with minor brushing. Rough site.
properties.Other Comments: Some supplies at Sullivan Bay 1 NM to E visible in photograph.

properties.Title: Cypress Harbour
properties.Landing Comments: Moderately steep beach in sheltered inlet. Patches of sand, grass but mainly mixed rocks at low, mid water. Sign visible from water.
properties.Camp Comments: 5 developed large double sites. 4 picnic tables. Fire rings. Pit toilet. Can be damp, buggy. Regrowth of small alders, bushes.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek 0.5 NM to E. Site might be former log dump.

properties.Title: Cane Point
properties.Landing Comments: Beach in small sheltered cove. Bedrock, boulder landing at high water only. Low water landings impractical on awkward boulder shore.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Clear grassy area, sloping rock ledge at SE end of beach.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Sometimes known as Mauve Islet or incorrectly as Mauve Point.

properties.Title: Deep Sea Bluff
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on smooth shell beach NW aspect, protected by reefs. Drift logs.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach camping for 2 tents on tiny tombolo, if tide less than 4.1 M Alert Bay but driftwood might prevent use. Upland accessible up steep bank with 3 potential rough tent sites, in need of brushing. Hammock opportunities. Site reported as unusable 2021.
properties.Other Comments: View. Wildlife viewing.

properties.Title: Polkinhorne Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Easy in cove with good protected clam bed beach with rock outcrop. Approach isthmus from S or shorter from NE using old boat run. Long carry at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: 1 good foreshore site possible at Neaps, 2 established upland tent sites. 1 marginal in forest, 1 excellent on grass, facing cove to S of landing site. Camp furniture. Slightly gloomy N aspect. Small exposed rock ledge site on rock peninsula.
properties.Other Comments: Strategic all-weather location. Attractive.

properties.Title: John Island southeast
properties.Landing Comments: Middle island in Benjamin Group has sheltered shell beach but mostly floods at high water.  SE aspect. Report of fallen trees at beach.
properties.Camp Comments: Level rock platforms at S end of cove. Some potential forest campsites usable if brushed.
properties.Other Comments: See Broughton Archipelago Provincial Park

properties.Title: Cockatrice Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Rough shallow beach with 30-60cm boulders. Sheltered except from W. Awkward at high water, but easier at all other water levels.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered, undeveloped. 1 good site to N of creek. 2 exposed tent sites on bedrock at shore. Others possible in trees with brushing. Little beach at high water. Hazardous dead standing snags/trees suggest avoiding use in high winds.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round creek. Wreck.

properties.Title: Dobbin Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Shallow mud beach with boulders. Impractical at lower tide levels.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Possible site to W of creek or at the head of the bay on solid rock which is dry at nearly all tides.
properties.Other Comments: Marginal site. Water at small creek.

properties.Title: Echo Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, pebble, shell beach. Seawall above with easy access to upland to S.  Dock and floats not maintained, taken out of service 2012.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered, mouldering toilet. Camp in large grass field.
properties.Other Comments: No water in park. Creek nearby. Post office, accommodation, store. museum. 2 marinas, private docks, anchorage. See Echo Bay Marine Provincial Park

properties.Title: Fox Group Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on gravel, shell, mud beach on Island 66 in Retreat Passage. At SW tip of island SW aspect. Good protection from SE. Fair protection from W. Steep bank access with short rope.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered tent sites. Camp in cleared areas in forest on small headland facing an isle across rocky neck. Suited to all weather. In conjunction with Kwikwasut’inuxw Haxwa’mis First Nations 12 tent platforms, 2 kitchen shelters, composting toilet added May 2023.
properties.Other Comments: Frequently used by commercial groups. Trails connect sites. Aka Retreat Passage. See Broughton Archipelago Provincial Park

properties.Title: Tracey Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy  at mid, high water on small shell beach or through narrow gap in high rock shelf. More awkward at lower water levels or land on beach to W and walk into campsite.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Small sheltered upland site in forest backed by cliff. S aspect. Beach or forest sites.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Frequent water taxi pick up/drop offs. Aka Monday Anchorage. See Broughton Archipelago Provincial Park

properties.Title: Dusky Cove north
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand, rock beach. Some boulders.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on rough grass. Likely wet at Springs.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Sedge Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on low gradient mud, mixed rocks beach in bay with S aspect. Alternative landing in long narrower SW aspect cove on W side of largest island has longer approach to site, but also easy on rock, cobble beach with mud, sand below. Well protected from swells. Long carries of 100 m at low water, but a report suggests much longer.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland gloomy, damp site with 2 cleared tent pads in salal. Suited to hammocks. W side bay has strip of grassy sand between beach, forest for possible additional sites, but might floods at Springs.
properties.Other Comments: Rough connecting trail between bays. See Broughton Archipelago Provincial Park

properties.Title: Cedar Island
properties.Landing Comments: Sand, gravel beach in cove at S end of island. SW aspect. Sand, pebble at high water. Cobble, some boulders, eelgrass at low water. May have surge. Currents in Providence Passage. Passage between Cedar, Midsummer Is dries.
properties.Camp Comments: Large clear area in gloomy forest. Some sites slope.
properties.Other Comments: Open to afternoon sun. Good alternative to Owl Is N. See Broughton Archipelago Provincial Park

properties.Title: Owl Island south
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on cobble, small boulders at high water, sand or smooth clam bed at low water. Boat run at centre beach. Protected bay. SW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered, undeveloped. Large clear upland area in forest. Hammock opportunities. At Neaps, beach top pebble tent sites possible at NW side of bay. Lowest tent sites soggy in wet weather. Several hazardous trees felled 2023/24 but some remain.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Modest view. See Broughton Archipelago Provincial Park

properties.Title: Lady Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered landing on small rocks. Sand at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Brushing needed. John Kimantas guide has camp at 50 38.53N 126 25.88W. Another location is on islet connected to E island (Little Lady Island). Various possibilities.
properties.Other Comments: View.

properties.Title: Crease Island north
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sheltered sand, pebble beach. Boulders at low water, easy to avoid.
properties.Camp Comments: Semi-developed. Beach or upland forest sites in rough clearings on W side of bay. One sandy beach site at E end. Pit toilet. condition unknown or now absent (2024). Mostly shaded, so often damp.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Crease Island south
properties.Landing Comments: Report received of poor landing on rough beach with big rocks.  Easier, on sand pebble, cobble beach at high water. Easier landing in bay to SW, (50.618,-126.647). but marginal at high water (assume beach floods).
properties.Camp Comments: Report of former sites being overgrown, entry from beach impassable due to blowdown. No visible tent sites. Previously assessed as Sheltered sites in young forest May need brushing. .
properties.Other Comments: Provincial Boat Haven.

properties.Title: Swanson Island west
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, on cobble, pebble beach. SW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Sheltered, undeveloped. 2 forest sites on S side of creek, 1 on N and 1 in farther N corner. Access awkward. Also camping on point reported.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Commercial use likely. Views.

properties.Title: Vernon Bay east
properties.Landing Comments: Enter creek mouth at S end of long, wide sand beach 350 m long. Turn after passing gravel berm. S aspect. Offers more shelter than open beach landing. Creek mouth may dry at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Some beach campsites present. Possible nearby location might be better or more accurate - reported by SeaTrails Charts Seattle, WA as N48D 59.9520M W125D 08.0640M (map datum unknown) so site could be further to W i.e. at opposite end of beach, away from creek mouth. However, this or another site was assessed at N48D 59.825M W125D 07.911M NAD 83 in creek mouth on grassy patch on N bank. Site might flood at Springs or in wet weather.
properties.Other Comments: Water nearby at year-round creek. Also nearby seep. Report of nearby resort partly overlooking site.

properties.Title: Eden Island east
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on smooth shell beach. Moderate gradient. Protected. SE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland sites in forest above high bank. Low forest slope. Beach top sites also feasible at Neaps, but forest comes to waterline, so overhung with branches. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Narrow trails. Broughton Archipelago Conservancy. Musgamakw Dzawada’enuxw sign asks for respect. Please observe BCMT Code of Conduct.

properties.Title: Spiller Passage
properties.Landing Comments: Landing at all but lowest tides best from west pocket beach behind rock promontory. Small cove with white shell beach. Steep wooded 'platform' above. Access from main E beach blocked 2025 by downed trees. May land on W side of rocky point instead.
properties.Camp Comments: NW corner has smooth stone point with flat rock midden earth step leading to isthmus-like feature. One visible good tent site just above the landing. Follow trail leading E about 100 m to 2-3 more forest sites.
properties.Other Comments: Large dead tree defines west edge of main tent site. When tree falls, it will uproot and destroy site. Good afternoon sun nearby. Seep in the woods possibly useable if filtered. In wetter year, water would likely be fine

properties.Title: Sandford Island
properties.Land Tenure: Crown tenure - Section 17 designated use area
properties.Landing Comments: Bay with partly protected sand beach 50 m long, E aspect. Strong surge at times.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland sites on gravel up 2 trails. Food hang rope. Camp furniture. Picnic table. Occasional commercial use. Coords reported as N48.86931, W125.16479. Toilet broken, non-functional.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive.

properties.Title: Holford Bay north
properties.Landing Comments: Beach W aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: No comments.
properties.Other Comments: Possible water source 50 m to S. Tzartus Island

properties.Title: Saranac Island
properties.Landing Comments: Easy but rocky at low tide. Large pebble, rock beach. SE aspect. Land in W portion of double bay.
properties.Camp Comments: 2 established sites in upland, about 4 on beach. E side beach might also have sites but rougher landing. Beach across neck to NW also has potential tent sites. Hammock opportunities,
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal streams in E bay or in next bay to S. Larger site than Robert Point. Remnants of a trail around point to another beach to NW.

properties.Title: Pacheendaht
properties.Landing Comments: Entering Gordon River mouth avoids any beach surf. Extensive sand beaches. Steep at river.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed commercial site. Toilets, shower, fire pits.
properties.Other Comments: No potable water (2009).

properties.Title: Sooke River Campground
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on gravel bars in river or tributary creek.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed campground. Grassy meadow. Showers, flush toilets. Picnic area. Fire pits. Seasonal opening 1 April.
properties.Other Comments: Water at tap. Owned by Sooke Community Association. Ph: (250) 642-6076 for reservations.

properties.Title: Muir Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Cobble, pebble beach. Exposed south facing beach but if able to access into creek, protected landing further up on either side of creek. One of the photos showing on map web site taken at extreme low tide when mouth of creek blocked by gravel/sand bar. 2023 assessment done at relatively high tide, sandbar across mouth of creek can create wave action.
properties.Camp Comments: Large sand, gravel area upland with gated road access to highway 500m. Unknown if camping is permitted.
properties.Other Comments: Large site to SE being developed 2009.

properties.Title: Sandstone Ledge
properties.Landing Comments: Awkward on exposed, sloping rock ledges, covered with fucus at low water. Surf possible when windy. Fair weather stop only. Landing, loading impractical in any significant waves. Short stair leads to upland. Current hazards in Porlier Pass.
properties.Camp Comments: Camping permitted at specified sites only, each with picnic table, gravel pad, several on bank above shore. Pit toilet. Access difficulty reduces value of site to paddlers. Food cache reported. No fires. This marine park has become a favorite bike-packing location and can be extremely busy. Wooden kayak racks at trailhead into campsites. Summer camp host at Parry Lagoon. Some overflow sites. Camping fees apply 1 May to 30 September. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2022) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
properties.Other Comments: Water at pump at Parry Lagoon must be boiled or treated. Rack for boat storage. Extensive hiking trails. Use by cyclists seems to be tolerated. Sandstone headlands, tidal lagoon to N. Wildlife viewing. See: Dionisio Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Gloucester Point
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on gravel, pebble, cobble beach. Scattered larger rocks. Exposed NE aspect but protected from E-W, S winds. Subject to outflow wind from Toba Inlet, presumably mostly in winter. Drift logs.
properties.Camp Comments: One site partly brushed in level forest. Possible marginal beach site(s) offers little clearance but usable at Neaps. Several additional sites could be brushed with effort in dense vegetation.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek, possibly seasonal, near centre beach slightly to W of site. Site of former homestead. Old trails or roads behind beach, largely overgrown.

properties.Title: Deer Passage
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on exposed low gradient gravel, cobble, boulder beach. General W aspect.  Vessel traffic. Low water landing at S point limited to single boats at a time.
properties.Camp Comments: Level clearings in upland forest. 10 m S of boulders follow path 4 m into upland above beach. Beach camping feasible at neaps. Fire ring. Point to S also feasible for 1 tent but more exposed. Another site in bight S of point to S has poorer landing in cove protected from NW but offers more shelter - option in rough conditions.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creeks which appear to be year-round. Small waterfall.

properties.Title: Hepburn Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, on low gradient beach of gravel, sand. Easy at mid, high water. Awkward oyster band at low water. Exposed NW aspect. Drift logs. Bay S of Hepburn Pt.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Potential for up to 8 sites with re-brushing of previously cleared areas, some now overgrown. 3-4 tent sites brushed 2023. 3 hammock hangs cleared. Beach camping at small tides. Path at forest opening right of fir among alders in centre beach.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek at bluff side of bay. Former logging camp, Some debris remains, Active log dump (2009) 200 m to NE or next bay NE. Dump appears inactive 2021.

properties.Title: Lewis Channel north
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on beach N of peninsula facing NW. Fine gravel at high water. Cobble, scattered boulders at low water. Mid tide rock band with boulders, rougher below. Beach floods to logs at Springs. Protected from S. Frequent boat wash. Vessel traffic. W wind funnels N in Lewis Channel.
properties.Camp Comments: Several brushed sites in open level forest. Good clear site N of 1 m x 3 m boulder at beach S end. Good potential for more sites if levelled. Beach camping feasible at most water levels.
properties.Other Comments: View. Attractive. Old roads lead into mature second growth forest.

properties.Title: Lewis Channel central
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on pebble, sand, rubble beach on N side of small point. A few boulders at low water. Band of rocks has smoother section at centre beach. Protected from S.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Small sites at back of point up short trail. Exposed to S. Beach camping tide dependent. Further sites in forest above beach with brushing.
properties.Other Comments: View. Attractive. Water possible at nearby seasonal creek. Aka Lewis Channel south

properties.Title: Roscoe Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on clam, oyster shell beach at head of long, very sheltered cove. Boat run cleared of oysters. Heavy vessel traffic particularly at high slack water for transits of narrow shoal entrance.
properties.Camp Comments: Grassy tent sites at bay head. Pit toilet. Food bin. Picnic table. Little privacy from many passers-by. Many boaters anchored in bay walk to lake through occupied campsites to avoid rougher beach. Camping fees apply 1 June to 15 September. Either pre-pay permit via Internet or at Lund or Okeover launch sites, but no reservable sites. Camp only at designated sites.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek or at broken pipe that drips water off cliff near trail to ruins. Lake another potential year-round source. Lake swimming nearby along hiking trail. Busy anchorage - no discharge zone. Hiking trail to viewpoint. See Roscoe Bay Provincial Park

properties.Title: Galley Bay
properties.Landing Comments: 2 cleared boat runs through boulders, mixed rocks on moderate gradient beach in protected bay. NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: 1 large site at beach top. Small trails might lead to other possible sites in sloped forest. Hammock opportunities. Fire pit on bluff.
properties.Other Comments: Stern ties for cruising boats. Aquaculture in bay. Some private homes. See Desolation Sound Marine Provincial Park

properties.Title: Gorges Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Various awkward or difficult bare rock shelves or on small rock, oyster beach. Significant oyster band at low water. Likely easier at high water. Generally protected from winds, swell. Landing choice depends on site selected for use.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites on rock ledges among bluffs. Favoured locations for paddlers on W island or on shelf at E side of main (E) island. Fire pit seen but No Fires rule in place.
properties.Other Comments: View. Attractive. Wildlife habitat to be avoided during Spring nesting season. Busy anchorage. Water in seasonal creek at Butler Point. Pipe may may collection easier. See Walsh Cove Provincial Park

properties.Title: Teakerne Arm
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on pebble, small cobble beach in cove behind rocky peninsula W of park boundary. SE aspect. Reported as not obvious to find.
properties.Camp Comments: Sloping grass bluffs of isthmus or peninsula have level areas of rock, grass. Geese evident on grass areas. Isthmus neck regularly floods at high water. Anchored pleasure boats reduce privacy.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Park day use area nearby - access by water - has anchorage, floating dock, pit toilet, waterfall, hiking trail, lake swimming. Paddlers have been known to camp there on flat rock. Lacks privacy.

properties.Title: Lloyd Creek
properties.Land Tenure: Crown tenure - Section 17 designated use area, Provincial Forest
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand, gravel, mixed cobble beach. Oyster band at lower water. N aspect.  Protected from S.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Camp in upland open forest N of creek. Berry bushes. Light brushing needed. Potential for more sites with brushng. Beach camping at lower tides.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. Oyster lease to N. View.

properties.Title: Elworthy Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate on cobble beach, rough at low water. Reefs.
properties.Camp Comments: 3 tent sites, 2 fire pits all usable. Some wooden structures remain from earlier squatter occupation.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. Part of site may be tenured as log dump. Anchorage.

properties.Title: Kinghorn Island
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate to difficult on moderately steep cobble, boulder beach E of headland. N aspect so exposed to NW. At mid water levels, narrow cleared boat run helps, but boulders above, below affect access at high, low water. Report received that rock ledge to N assists. High winds could make leaving difficult. tough landing, Beach floods to trees, drift logs. Another landing around headland might be easier on low gradient pebble beach. NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Upland cleared sites in forest. Terrain flattens behind beach. Benches, fire pit. Rustic kitchen furniture. Olive barrel for food storage. Well shaded. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Views. Water at creek. Site regularly used by paddlers. Historic anchorage of Captain Vancouver. Occasional use by large guided parties.

properties.Title: Martin Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on either N or S of tombolo except S side reported blocked by log (2022). Shale, gravel with cleared boat run on N side running W to E through boulders, visible when close. S side has many drift logs.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Sheltered large clear site in centre, smaller areas on W island. Picnic table, benches. Suited to groups. Potential for more sites. 3 or more upland fire pits.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. On dry tombolo - islands not completely split as shown on chart. High use requires attention to good sanitation practices. Report received of high use by instructional or commercial groups for prolonged periods.

properties.Title: Openit east cove
properties.Landing Comments: nan
properties.Camp Comments: nan
properties.Other Comments: This site is currently closed. Site closures may occur for a variety of reasons including environmental protection, weather-related damage, safety concerns or directives from First Nations. BC Marine Trails will update this site’s status as new information becomes available. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in helping preserve these areas for future generations.

properties.Title: Sansum Narrows
properties.Landing Comments: 2 pebble beaches of moderate gradient with 1 m high bank. Beaches sit between small rock outcrops. A reporter could not find suitable landing beach at high water (3.6 m). NW aspect. Currents, vessel traffic.
properties.Camp Comments: Dispersed camping permitted. Moderately level sites in attractive open forest, some on old roadbed, about 20 m above either of pebble beaches. Minor brushing likely required. No fires. Precise location might vary depending on site chosen. A reporter could find no suitable tent sites 2023.
properties.Other Comments: Water at nearby seasonal creek. View. Hiking trail located 200 m to SE connects with main park trail #20 near junction with #23. Hydro right of way trail not maintained entirely. See: Burgoyne Bay Provincial Park.

properties.Title: South Kendrick Islet
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate to difficult, on rock ledges at W shore approx 70 m SE of main tenting area indicated on map.  Easier at low water. Swells, current hazards, vessel traffic.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped, large semi-exposed grassy level area on islet top.
properties.Other Comments: West Vancouver Yacht Club outstation nearby on main Kendrick Island W shore. Anchorage. Adjacent to Wakes Cove Provincial Park but not within Park.

properties.Title: Klaskino Lagoon
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient sand beach makes for long carry at low water.  More protected than Keith R Site 4.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on beach. Possible upland sites.
properties.Other Comments: Adjacent to clearcut.

properties.Title: Klaskino Site 1
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on steep gravel beach at N end of long beach.  Beach to S not accessible from seaward because of blocking reefs.
properties.Camp Comments: Very limited space at Springs. 6 or more sites otherwise.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Battle Bay Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Easy landing on protected sand beach inside deep cove. S aspect. Moderately steep at low tide, accessible at all tides. Approach from SW. Other coves in vicinity. A cove to E appears connected, but is usually separated by jagged rocks.
properties.Camp Comments: 2 beach sites on pebble, small stones. Possible upland sites if heavily brushed. An area of sea grass could yield tent sites at Neaps. Hammock use also require brushing.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. See: Mquqwin Brooks Peninsula Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Too Tah Island
properties.Land Tenure: Treaty Settlement Land designated for public access
properties.Landing Comments: Easy landing on sheltered sand beach at all tides. NE aspect. Alternate approaches, landings on beaches with W, S aspects.
properties.Camp Comments: 3 sheltered upland tent sites on treed neck between 2 beaches. Large private cabin with private outhouse at W aspect beach - no permission for public use of either. Exposed beach top sites suitable at Neaps but maybe not at Springs.
properties.Other Comments: First Nations (KCFN) owned Maa-Nulth Treaty land. Reasonable public access to be provided. Fees not currently charged (2023). Aka Barneys Island or Gay Passage Island. Frequent water taxi drop-off / pick up site. Indirect report of campers being asked to leave when cabin owner is present.

properties.Title: Nipple Mountain
properties.Landing Comments: Choose from S or N facing beaches. S side easy to moderate on steep pebble beach, various rocks.  N side easy on moderately sloped sand, pebble beach. Dumping surf in high swell can likely be avoided on one side or other. N side reported usually easier.
properties.Camp Comments: Many camping possibilities on beach, upland either side of small peninsula. 1 good upland site on S beach. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Water at S beach clear creek believed to be year-round. Swim hole. Trail between N & S beaches. Some hiking trails along creek on S beach. IMAP shows REC136267 Provincial Recreation Reserve.

properties.Title: Santa Gertrudis Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Easy. Small shale, gravel beach in very protected cove. E aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Reporter did not see the picnic table or the clearing which was described in earlier write ups. The landing is otherwise as described although there were many logs. 3-4 upper beach sites available behind the logs.
properties.Other Comments: At Santa Gertrudis Cove, there is the main cove visible when entering and three smaller coves to the north. The closest cove is eel grass and mud at low tide. The small cove to the ocean becomes a passage at higher tides. Hiking trail to Jewitt Lake. https://bcparks.ca/santa-gertrudis-boca-del-infierno-park/Gloomy. See: Santa Gertrudis - Boca del Infierno Marine Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Ross Islets
properties.Landing Comments: Crushed shell beach. Mixed rocks, cobbles lower. Approach from E at all tides. Access at high water from W, N.
properties.Camp Comments: Small sites in relatively close proximity. Protected.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive but impacted heavily by users. Frequent use. Reported in July 2024: Established kitchen area used by boaters and paddlers. Grills left at site. .

properties.Title: Keeha Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Crescent sand beach, rocky headlands. S aspect. Expect surf ranging upwards from minor in 1 m swell to heavy in high swell.  Easier at N end (IR) in NW conditions.  Could land at IR then wheel craft to within park.
properties.Camp Comments: Toilet. Food cache. May be subject to park use restrictions e.g. no pets. Reservable dates in 2022 May 1, 2022 - October 11, 2022.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Hiking trail to Bamfield 3.5 km, so expect heavy use. Suited to calm weather. Pacific Rim National Park Reserve. AKA Keeha Beach.

properties.Title: Kirby Point southwest
properties.Landing Comments: E end of sand beach. SW aspect. Sheltered by island. Turbulent water likely at entrance in SW swell.
properties.Camp Comments: Camping fees are normally charged. Permit required for overnight use. See: =Camping Permit. Rustic beach huts are no longer present. Any previous above beach camping areas were overgrown. We did not see anywhere to put a tent. A native graveyard was seen.
properties.Other Comments: Huu-ay-aht Treaty Settlement Land.

properties.Title: Jepther Point
properties.Landing Comments: Moderately steep cobble, pebble beach. Difficult in high swell. Landing easier at either end of the beach.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach sites on gravel, cobble.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water at creek. No access to N Coast hiking Trail. Reported (7-2024) they were unable to locate any streams or other water sources or any dry creek beds. Also stated that water was available approximately 2.5km East along the coastline.See: Cape Scott Provincial Park

properties.Title: Tent Island
properties.Landing Comments: nan
properties.Camp Comments: nan
properties.Other Comments: This site is currently closed. Site closures may occur for a variety of reasons, including environmental protection, weather-related damage, safety concerns, or directives from First Nations. BC Marine Trails will update this site’s status as new information becomes available. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in helping preserve these areas for future generations.

properties.Title: Carl’s Crab Shack and Nytom
properties.Landing Comments: White sand beach. Surf tends to wrap around the point to W but  beach 10 m to S of site has a  channel with good sand landing. A  floating line usually marks entry. Keep rope on immediate port side.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach camping on sand. Not a recognized Parks Canada site.
properties.Other Comments: Seasonal food may be available from temporary restaurant/cafe.

properties.Title: Pacific Lions Marina
properties.Landing Comments: No comments.
properties.Camp Comments: Grassy sites. RV use. Services.
properties.Other Comments: 4 day minimum. Might apply to boat-based camping.

properties.Title: Coon Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on low gradient sand beach, steeper at top. N aspect. Surf possible in strong NW conditions. Alternate access by Parry Lagoon to SE of tombolo. Enter SE'most  lagoon entrance. Very low gradient, dries at low water. Third landing option 400 m to W of tombolo on moderate gradient gravel in well-protected Maple Bay. Longer carry but on good trail. High current, turbulence hazards in adjacent Porlier Pass.  Vessel traffic stays mostly well to N.
properties.Camp Comments: Camping permitted only at specified forested sites away from shore. Each has gravel pad, picnic table. No fires. Shoreline for day use only. Pit toilets. Resident camp host in summer. Benches. Camping fees apply 1 May to 30 September. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2022) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Water at pump May - September must be boiled or treated. Former village site named Quelus'. Swimming. Sandstone headlands, wildflowers, tidal lagoon. Wildlife viewing. No sanctioned road or trail access. Extensive hiking trails. Car-based camping discouraged, Used (unauthorized) by cyclists. Regularly visited by power boaters. See: Dionisio Provincial Park

properties.Title: Quarry Bay Finlayson Arm
properties.Landing Comments: No comments
properties.Camp Comments: Secluded site used by campers and picnickers. Firepit.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Edward King Island west
properties.Landing Comments: Small rocky beach has tiny pullout on N side. Little or no surf.
properties.Camp Comments: Two upland sites, one small beach site. Secluded but rough. Two sources of water reported on SE shore of same island
properties.Other Comments: Good picnic site.

properties.Title: Proud Outlook
properties.Landing Comments: Rough landing on slightly rounded rocks. At low water mixed rocks to 150+ mm.  At high water boulders range from 300 - 500 mm. Steep 20% grade to upland. 0.4 NM SW of Camp Potlatch.
properties.Camp Comments: Pleasant upland tent sites beside creek, 2 in trees, 1 slightly lower in open glade. Sites 2 - 3 m above high water. Sunny.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek that appears to run year-round. Small waterfall. Potlach Creek 0.5 NM to NE has sure year-round water. Attractive. View.

properties.Title: Kin Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate to low gradient cobble, sand beach. NE aspect. Extensive cobble at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed vehicle-accessible campsite. Pit toilets. Playground. Picnic shelters. Day use area. Campsite reservations recommended. Call 250-339-6365. Group site.
properties.Other Comments: Vehicle access via Ryan Road, to entrance to 19 Wing Comox. Turn left on Little River Road, right on Kilmorley Road. Stay left to the park. For closest parking to water go beyond park entrance to picnic shelter then approx 150 m further. Water at tap. Small store. Community-run Class C park. See: Kin Beach Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Qualicum First Nation Campground
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, protected pebble beach, more exposed at low tide. Optional launch in river.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed commercial campground. Full facilities, tent pads, hookups, store, picnic shelter, picnic tables, playground, toilets, showers, sani dump. Site on S bank is let by season. Operates May-Sept. Gates closed 9 pm to 7 am. Fees charged.
properties.Other Comments: Road access at 5861 Island Highway West (Hwy 19A). Operated by Qualicum First Nation Ph: 250-757-9322, 250-757-9337 (Oct-June). See <Qualicum First Nation Campground

properties.Title: Willingdon Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Easy  on moderate gradient beach. SW aspect. Mixed pebble, sand to E of breakwater jetty, cobble to W.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed municipal campground. Full facilities. Showers, electric hookups. Flush toilets, laundry room. Fire pits, picnic tables. Playground, water park. All sites reservable.at 604.485.2242 or reservations@willingdonbeach.ca. Group campsite.
properties.Other Comments: 4845 Marine Avenue, Powell River. View. Parking. Water at taps. Swimming float. 1.5 km walk to central Powell River with all amenities. Hiking trails. Good launch site.

properties.Title: Fairview Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Mixed low gradient beach in bay, mostly 30 - 60 mm gravel. SE aspect. Some oysters, scattered boulders, patches of gravel, sand. Moderately long carry at low water. Easy shore access up low bank with trail.
properties.Camp Comments: One wooden tent pad, one clearing, one smaller site for tents. Might be more tent sites further from cabin but not seen. Beautiful public use cabin or hut built by volunteers 2009, modified, renovated 2014. Accommodates 10 in upper sleeping loft. Composting outhouse toilet (2016). Paddlers advised to carry tent because hut often full. Reservations not accepted. Picnic tables, outside fire pit, sleeping loft, covered porch. No lighting, stove or heater.
properties.Other Comments: Year-round water nearby. View. Hut part of Sunshine Coast hiking Trail. Sections lead along coast to Saltery Bay (2 -3 hr), or N to Rainy Day Lake, Sarah Point terminus (173 km). Under care of Powell River Parks and Wilderness Society. Swimming. Oysters. See Sunshine Coast Trail

properties.Title: Gastineau Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand, pebble beach, some boulders. S aspect. Rougher at low water. Might be awkward due to drift logs at very high water.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Cleared sites in trees. With brushing, many others possible
properties.Other Comments: Water at creeks to S. View. Attractive. Shelter from outflow winds. Intended log dump use. Licencee willing to remove boom in bay and not use site in summer months. Per F Ullman RSTBC. Aka Toba Inlet Entrance.

properties.Title: Attwood Bay entrance
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, on gravel beach with angular cobble above. Land N of creek mouth. Boat run at low - mid water levels. Little beach at high water, floods to treeline. Log boom may be across small bay mouth. W aspect. Exposed to W which causes strong chop at landing but not known to cause actual surf.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Some rough clearings N of creek. Good potential. If brushed, further tent sites feasible on flat dry ground growing ferns, brambles. Minor deadfall needs clearing. Hazard trees likely. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Water at seasonal creek with small waterfall. Creek might have year-round flow. Bathing opportunities. Float homes, development in bay to N. Log dump nearby to N.

properties.Title: Carriden Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Land in large protected bay on moderate to low gradient boulder beach at high water, Extensive low gradient clam bed at low water. Paddlers might avoid long low water carry by landing 150 m to SW of site. E aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites along faint trail at S side of stream in second growth forest. Grassy upper beach patches may offer additional sites at Neaps. Hammock opportunities.Many other camp possibilities within large bay. Approx. 700 m to S are beaches NE aspect bounded by a tall cliff. Land on boulders, cobble, mixed rocks, pebble. Protected. Low slope forest behind beach, but no tent sites seen July 2023. Dry seasonal stream.
properties.Other Comments: Water at stream with lake source flowing in drought mid-July 2023 - assume year-round. Larger year-round creek 350 m to N at N50.9135, W126.9062. No tent sites seen there. Anchorage. Large 111.9 Ha. Provincial Recreation Site.

properties.Title: Burdwood Point south 2
properties.Landing Comments: Navigate through rocks to small medium gradient sand, pebble beach. Beach moderately well protected by rocks on approach. More protected, less surf than Burdwood Bay.
properties.Camp Comments: 10 tent sites on beach at tombolo, 2 more in upland. Cabin behind rock outcrop, tombolo. Old toilet along trail S of cabin. Potential for beach flooding at springs but tombolo normally dry. Safe refuge in rough conditions.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Swim hole. Walking trail leads N from cabin.

properties.Title: Kitty Coleman
properties.Landing Comments: 2 paved boat ramps, one in  creek mouth other larger ramp at road end to N. Cobble beach. Exposed to wind.
properties.Camp Comments: Vehicle-accessible sites. Group camping by reservation in summer 250-338-1332. Picnic shelter, picnic tables, pit toilets. Shared fire pits. Many narrow gravel sites on waterfront.
properties.Other Comments: Vehicle enter via Coleman Road off Hwy 19A. Turn on Left Road, right on Whittaker Road. Parking. Water might require boiling. Nature trails. Swimming, 900 m shoreline. Community-run Class C park. See: Kitty Coleman Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Shingle Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sheltered beach of low gradient sand, gravel, pebble, mud, clam bed with angular stones, on NE side of bay with NW aspect. Protected by rocky headland, islet, reefs. Land at N side of open grass tent area in old orchard. Mud, weed at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Large gravel tent pads, picnic tables, in shaded orchard, vault toilet, kiosk, food lockers. No potable water. Hammock opportunities but may not use fruit trees, oaks or arbutus trees. Limit 5 persons per site, 2 tents/site. Fees charged year-round. Small overflow area for 3 tents lacks tables. All sites reservable Reservations advised in summer. Phone needed to call in on arrival if not already reserved. No fires permitted. 250-654-4000, Toll-free: 1-866-944-1744
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Gulf Islands National Park Reserve. Gated steep road access 240 m from end of Shingle Bay Road. Site shared with cyclists, walk-in users. Hiking trails. Small parking area for overnight use at gate. Irene Bay offers best local hand launch site. See camping

properties.Title: Klashkish Inlet
properties.Landing Comments: Steep gravel beach at high tide. Low gradient at mid, low tide. Gravel berm at beach top.
properties.Camp Comments: Level sites on pebble berm top.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek in small bay to E.

properties.Title: Shehtekwahn east bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on broad moderate gradient beach of sand, gravel, pebble, other rocks. Drift logs. Scattered boulders. ENE aspect, protected from NW.
properties.Camp Comments: A few small beach sites on sand among logs. Level upland areas in trees with sites for several tents, subject to minor brushing, levelling. Visible hazard trees. Crude camp furniture. Fire ring.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal stream crossing centre beach approx 200 m from site. Road or trail access so use possible by vehicle-based campers, fishers.

properties.Title: Holford Bay south
properties.Landing Comments: Protected beach in cove of small cobble, broken rock. SW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Coordinates might refer to landing . Sea Trails Charts Seattle WA show a site 150 m to N at N48D 56.220M W125D 05.052M. Likely the same site but no further information.
properties.Other Comments: Tzartus Island.

properties.Title: Diana Island northeast
properties.Land Tenure: Crown tenure - Section 17 designated use area, Crown?
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand, gravel beach. Access between rock reefs at low water. N aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach top sites behind drift logs. Upland forest sites. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive.

properties.Title: Baronet Passage west
properties.Landing Comments: Clam bed beach in protected cove with pebble at high water, cobble, boulders at lower water levels. NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Some upland sites in second growth forest. Brushing likely needed.
properties.Other Comments: 2013 Conservancy management plan suggests new site in vicinity. See Qwiquallaaq/Boat Bay Conservancy.

properties.Title: Northeast Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient broad open pebble beach with mixed rocks to 100 mm. Creek estuary in  wide bay, exposed to N. May approach up creek channel at low tide. Alternate landing on steeper gravel beach immediately to SE, with access to similar upland.
properties.Camp Comments: Sites among forest margin. Several sites to S of creek where trail from road enters. 1 or 2 sites on N side of creek. Potential for additional sites with brushing or could camp directly on old road.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Water at year-round Russ Creek, small waterfall, bathing pool. ATV access via broad trail or old road from larger main island road. AKA Russ Creek. UREP recreational status. Noted for recreational value by Regional District.

properties.Title: Single Tree Point
properties.Landing Comments: S of point proper, low gradient broad gravel, pebble beach at all water levels, steeper at top. Smooth area in centre between boulder, bedrock bands perpendicular to shoreline. Kelp.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach top camp on gravel between drift logs dry at most tides. Minor brushing will give 1-2 upland sites. Hammock opportunities. Fire pit.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal stream (Suquash Creek) E of point, flowing in drought mid-July 2023. Route of inactive industrial road runs behind shore. Former Suquash village site assumed located in vicinity.

properties.Title: Crabapple Islets
properties.Landing Comments: Sand beach NW aspect. Easier landing than Marks Creek. Landing good in the bay behind islets.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach sites. Random wilderness camping permitted. No fees (2018).
properties.Other Comments: See: <Mquqwin Brooks Peninsula Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Cape Cook Lagoon
