properties.Camp Comments: Camp among drift logs on sand beach at neaps or on beach grass by creek at higher water levels. Beach at N end reported dry at 3.9 m water level. Dense vegetation makes upland camping difficult but upland access feasible.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water at seasonal creek crossing centre beach. Island at bay mouth 11 m high, not 1 m as charted on CHS 3547. CMTs.

properties.Title: Warren Islands north
properties.Landing Comments: Land at NE point on bedrock ramp or on shell, boulder tiny beach. Protected from W.
properties.Camp Comments: Small bluff sites at NE tip. Fire ring, camp furniture. Easy carry.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View.

properties.Title: Deep Harbour Narrows
properties.Landing Comments: Protected rough beach with broken rocks, some scattered boulders. Moderate gradient. NE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: 3 sites on grassy forest edge, subject to moderate tides. Could be damp in wet weather. 1 site on duff at forest margin. Adjacent inactive log dump to W has overgrown level sites in former clearings or roads, subject to brushing. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water possible but unlikely at seasonal stream crossing landing. Inactive log dump (2004, 2014) to W. Seasketch shows no licence or tenure here so industrial tenure might be retired.

properties.Title: Call Inlet north entrance
properties.Landing Comments: Beach of angular cobble beach with gravel above. Land at creek mouth fan.
properties.Camp Comments: Site on bank of W creek in open woods. Hammock opportunities. Another site is 200 m to W in level forest at grassy beach top. Steep forest behind. Poor landing on boulders.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round creek, flowing during mid-July 2023 drought.

properties.Title: Cattle Islands north
properties.Landing Comments: Sand beach. Channel protected, suited for lining out boat.
properties.Camp Comments: N of sand tombolo. Quite long carry.
properties.Other Comments: nan

properties.Title: Estítkw Apodaca
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate gradient coarse gravel beach in small drying cove. Boulders with wide gaps at low water. S aspect. Sheltered from N outflow wind but exposed to S. Little or no beach area at Springs. Prone to accumulate drift logs. Ship wash from frequent passing ferries. Vessel traffic.
properties.Camp Comments: 4 tent platforms on level mossy benches high above beach. Access trail up steep bank near creek steers users away from sensitive bluffs. No fires. No overflow sites - to preserve vegetation. Composting green throne roofless toilet. Food cache bin, Canoe/kayak rack. Kiosk with signage
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Seasonal water at Optimist Creek. Waterfall, pool. Ecological values unique rocky knoll vegetation. Higher elevations are Ecological Reserve. See Apodaca Provincial Park Squamish language name (Coast Salish) Estítkw. Pronunciation how to pronounce name

properties.Title: Islet View Lhemlhemḵwús
properties.Landing Comments: Cleared boat run through boulder beach, 5-10% grade. Substrate pebble, sand, mud. S aspect. Protected by low treeless rock islet. Prominent sign visible from water.
properties.Camp Comments: 2 small, 1 larger cleared sites along upland strip of level ground. 2 or more sites up trail with steps to composting toilet. 2 wooden tent platforms along shore to E. Steel food bin. Any fires must be on beach only. Visitor log book, shared picnic table. Some users have blocked use of some tent sites with table etc. Please share this small site, its table and beach fire ring with other users.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Very small seasonal creek. Larger year round creek, waterfall 250 m to SW accessible by boat only. Avoid disturbing birds, seals on islet. Squamish (Coast Salish) name Lhemlhemḵwús. Site stewards: Sea Kayak Assn of BC.

properties.Title: Von Donop entrance
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on pebble, cobble beach. Drift logs. Protected by islet.
properties.Camp Comments: Level clearing in upland forest. Undeveloped user maintained dispersed camping. Might be partly overgrown.
properties.Other Comments: View. See Ha'thayim (Von Donop) Marine Provincial Park. Hazard - please note there are many snags and danger trees on this site. Not recommended on any windy day. Exercise caution.

properties.Title: Elk Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, on pebble beach but exposed to N.
properties.Camp Comments: Vehicle accessible site can also accommodate tents. 2 sites are S of creek, separate from main group. Toilets, picnic tables, fire rings. Maintained.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. View. Boat launch. See:  Elk Bay Recreation Site

properties.Title: Cinque Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Two bays on Sonora Is 150 m apart separated by rocky promontory.  S bay has better beach of sand, pebblr, cobble, boulders. N bay landing rougher with sharp rocks, Beaches mostly flood at high water. W aspect. Ship wash.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped marginal sites. Camp in trees. Some brushing needed. N site rougher than S but less damp..
properties.Other Comments: Water in N bay at stream from lake, so may be year-round. Aka Cinque Islands inside.

properties.Title: Loggers Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy, pebble beach, exposed. Rougher with boulders on N side at low water. Currents, vessel traffic.
properties.Camp Comments: Exposed to W. Large site. Camp either side of creek on grass in alders or on grassy small headland on N side of bay.
properties.Other Comments: View. Water at small seasonal creek. View. Aka 'South of Point 45'. John Kimantas gives position as 50 12.75N 125 21.39W. Believed to be former log dump. Beach fires are banned all year round.

properties.Title: Arm Islands
properties.Land Tenure: Crown tenure - Section 17 designated use area
properties.Landing Comments: Pocket gravel beach among boulders on E side at NE tip of main, longest island. Protected from all directions.
properties.Camp Comments: Small lumpy upland forest margin sites above landing. Might flood at Springs. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek 150 m to E on mainland shore. Passage to N reported navigable by small craft at all water levels to N of small islet. Seasketch shows as Provincial Forest or Crown rather than Sec 17 Reserve, so land tenure unclear.

properties.Title: Deep Harbour south
properties.Landing Comments: Small shell, pebble beach. N end of beach between rock points.
properties.Camp Comments: Usable tent site seen. Access to forest up steep bank. Several potential sites if brushed or deadfall moved. Lumpy site, steeper behind. Marginal as camp.
properties.Other Comments: Year-round water reported approx 50 m up from creek mouth but not viewed July 2023. Might be former village site along E bank of main creek. Musgamakw Dzawada’enuxw traditional territory sign.

properties.Title: Sangster Island
properties.Landing Comments: Long sand, pebble beach.Drift logs. SE aspect. Smaller beach on opposite side of peninsula has NW aspect, so one or other should be sheltered.
properties.Camp Comments: Entire island is private. Foreshore suited to short-term bivouac or emergency camp.
properties.Other Comments: Situated close to crossing from Winchelseas to Lasqueti.

properties.Title: Peel Island west
properties.Landing Comments: 2 small beaches of white shell at high water, boulders, weed at low water. SW aspect. Easier access from S.
properties.Camp Comments: At one time, semi-developed camp with covered picnic shelter. Subsequently returned to more natural state, so might need minor brushing. Open to NW wind.
properties.Other Comments: Windows and garbage collected on site March 2025. View of Fort Rupert and Seven Hills Peninsula.

properties.Title: Thornbrough Channel txwnaḿ Chá7elkwnech
properties.Landing Comments: Cleared boat run on small cobbles, pebble, through gaps in boulders, 5-10% grade.  Exposed S aspect. Several options at low water but limited pocket beach only at high water. Prone to blockage by drift logs. Alternate beach 30 m to W at creek mouth has smaller more rounded stones, but access to tent sites more awkward. Reasonable portable boat stowage at beach top at candelabra cedars. Prominent sign visible from water.
properties.Camp Comments: 2 very small level cleared sites in steep forested upland near landing. 4 large wooden tent platforms, several other small sites on open mossy rock bluffs to SW accessed by bridge across creek then up steep, rough trail. 200 m carry to upper sites. Composting toilet on trail high above landing. Aluminum food bin near landing below trail, lower tent sites. Second bin higher. Visitor log book. 2 picnic tables intended for sharing near platforms. Fire bucket at landing. No fires in upland.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Sunny beach, bluff, view. Keep to cleared trails on bluffs to prevent damage to mosses, vegetation. Squamish (Coast Salish) name txwnaḿ Chá7elkwnech. Aka Thornbrough Point. Site stewards: Sea Kayak Assn of BC.

properties.Title: Rathtrevor
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient sand beach in Craig Bay. Exposed. From E very long (900 m) carry at low water. From N or NE approx 200 m carry to cobble spit at Brandt Point. Advisable to avoid low water due to tidally-dependent access.
properties.Camp Comments: Large developed campground, Walk-in tent camping in separate pleasant field with picnic tables. Full facilities including water, parking, washrooms, showers, picnic tables, shelters. Playground. Nature house. Group sites. Reservations BC Parks
properties.Other Comments: 3 km S of Parksville on Highway 19A, Take exit 51 off Inland Island Highway (Highway 19) and follow signs. Water at taps, Wildlife viewing. Attractive. See: Rathtrevor Beach Park Fees apply year-round.

properties.Title: Christie Passage
properties.Landing Comments: Not visible from main passage. Protected beach in sheltered bay approx. 500 m SW of God's Pocket resort.
properties.Camp Comments: Up steep bank 4 M high on obvious midden. A nice sand/rock beach that is accessible both low and high tides. 4 - 5 tent sites are available in the grass area as well the forest. . No facilities. Random wilderness camping. No fees charged. Obvious midden location, so avoid all fires except on beach. 50° 50.278'N 127° 35.618'W
properties.Other Comments: Entrance to the campsite area is very steep. Alternate entrance under trees to the left of main entrance is not as steep. See: God's Pocket Marine Provincial Park

properties.Title: Walkem Bay central 2
properties.Landing Comments: Easy landing on cobble beach. Sw aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Easy upland access. Mossy forest with some level areas. Minor brushing likely needed.
properties.Other Comments: Site lies on border with Turn Bay Recreation Site immediately to N.

properties.Title: Walkem Bay central 1
properties.Landing Comments: Small rough beach of cobble, boulders. SW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Access at creek mouth through dense salal forest fringe to open dark forest with some level areas.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek.

properties.Title: Bear Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Difficult on exposed rocky beach of cobble, some boulders at high water. Sand at low water. Potential for high surf, particularly in Fall, Winter, Spring. Swell normal. Watch for a back eddy at the point that gives protection from surf.
properties.Camp Comments: 10 platforms added 2023/24. 2 food bins. Pit toilet. Access to camping area via hiking trail reportedly requires 3 m or lower tide height, but unclear if this is maximum tide level to access site from landing beach. Approximate location only. Fire pits. Camping fees apply year-round. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $10.00 per adult per night (2018) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
properties.Other Comments: Hiker use. Old growth forest. On Juan De Fuca hiking trail. See: Juan de Fuca Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Meade Bay south
properties.Landing Comments: Rock ledges at point W of islet or rough beach adjacent to smooth rocks.
properties.Camp Comments: At moderate tides camp on flat bedrock shelf rock at shore.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View.

properties.Title: Bassett Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected beach of gravel, large pebbles, small cobble. Larger rocks at low water. E aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on possibly damp road end. 3 or 4 above beach, others to N of creek in upland. Some local access evident. Benches for hikers at trail end. Fallen tree blocks one site (2017). Potential for additional sites.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek at N end of beach by campsites. Recreation Site or Reserve. Mainly intended for Eagle Lake where setup is for day use. Well-marked trail or rough road connects on S branch to Eagle Lake, Big Bay (3 km), on N branch to airstrip (1 km) . Bassett Bay is local name; not charted. Anchorage. Another possible site lies 450 m NE but has poorer landing.

properties.Title: Meade Bay northeast
properties.Landing Comments: Creek mouth in cove at NE side of bay. Protected clam bed beach with cobble, some boulders at top. W aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Large level site in second growth forest on N side of estuary above a small flat.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round creek.

properties.Title: Kains Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Rocky approach. Seek the clear entry route through from Pinnacle Island to prominent sea stack near shore.
properties.Camp Comments: Roomy sand, pebble beach. Some protection from SW, NW. Might be little room at Springs.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View.

properties.Title: Favada Point south
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate landing on slightly steep cobble beach in small cove. Pebble, drift logs at top. Floods at Springs. 3 other possible landings in coves to NW.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on beach or forest margin except during Springs when 1 or 2 small sites high on mossy bluffs may be used, Hammock opportunities. Brushing, levelling could yield more tent sites.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal stream. Flagged trail leads up bluffs to unknown destination, possibly residence.

properties.Title: Texada Island north
properties.Landing Comments: 200 mm boulders low tide, 75 mm cobble at high tide.
properties.Camp Comments: Pocket beach may flood at Springs. Upland awkward to access but at least 1 party camped here.
properties.Other Comments: Marginal site but potentially useful in a pinch.

properties.Title: Grilse Point
properties.Landing Comments: Easy to moderate om steep cobble, pebble, gravel beach at all tides, 15% slope. Vessel traffic. Optional cove landing on E shore with possibility of more protection but longer more awkward carry.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped, Occasionally also used for camping. Attractive flat gravel berm area just above beach but not visible from water level. Some shelter. Sites on grass roadway also feasible,
properties.Other Comments: View. Large quarries nearby. Ferry service to Powell R from Blubber Bay, 0.7 NM to SW. Land tenure relates to navigation, communications aids on shore.

properties.Title: Fegen Islets west
properties.Landing Comments: Steep wide gravel beach at SE corner of islet. High water access easier. NE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Roomy beach camping on gravel. Exposed.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. See Sabine Channel Marine Provincial Park

properties.Title: Powerline east
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered landing near creek mouth, large boulder, on beach of rounded cobble. NE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Grassy sites among trees. Camp furniture. upland fire ring. Close to creek bank.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek with near year-round flow. Trail, BC Hydro access road nearby leading to primary island roads. AKA Long Beach.

properties.Title: Powerline west
properties.Landing Comments: Low to moderate gradient smooth beach of gravel, pebble, sand. Drift logs. S aspect. Larger E beach preferred over SW aspect beach under lines. Protected from several directions by rocky islet.
properties.Camp Comments: Grass areas under trees. Possible beach top sites. Hammock opportunities. Sites further from lines likely to be found 300 m to SE along beach. Another suitable potential camping beach lies 0.5 NM to SE.
properties.Other Comments: Water at large seasonal creek 300 m to SE. RD Official Community Plan notes as UREP with high recreational potential. Mapping shows BC Hydro right of way for transmission line. Some land near shore Crown lease. West Texada Island Cable Terminal. Road might be private (gated) until it joins FSR Davie Bay/Shingle Beach Roads 400 m from Terminal.

properties.Title: Cockburn Roberts Homesite
properties.Landing Comments: Pea gravel, 15% slope at low water. S aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Semi-developed. 10 or more tent sites on several grassy level areas, some on old roadbed. Unenclosed pit toilet (Green Throne) presumably installed by Regional District. Several 'No Fires' signs on this and adjacent BC Hydro site. Camping neither officially sanctioned nor prohibited by Regional District but known to occur ,evidently tolerated.
properties.Other Comments: Beach locally known as Harry's Beach (after Harry Roberts). Old home nearby at W end on adjacent leased property owned by BC Hydro is historic Roberts homestead Sunray. Boundary not marked between private land held by BC Hydro, SCRD Regional Park. Respectful camping without fire use also permitted there. Avoid entering sensitive wetlands behind beach area.

properties.Title: Buccaneer Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on moderate gradient sand beach in large semi-enclosed bay, protected from waves from most directions. E aspect. Landing also easy but more exposed on outer W aspect sand beach.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp in designated sites only in sandy flats. 2 pit toilets. 5 Fire rings. 5 Picnic tables. Metal food cache. No reservable sites, no user fees (2023). Park operator reported to not tolerate overflow camping if designated sites already occupied. Paddlers, boaters have been required to move at short notice. Site has no wind or sun protection except for pole structures that could be enclosed with a tarp.
properties.Other Comments: View, trail to N Thormanby boat dock. Aka Grassy Point. Frequent use by power boaters. See Buccaneer Bay Provincial Park

properties.Title: Broken Islands Lodge
properties.Landing Comments: Paddlers can launch from beach in front of the lodge or possibly from the dock.
properties.Camp Comments: n/a; Broken Islands Lodge houses paddlers.
properties.Other Comments: The Broken Islands Lodge provides round trip water taxi transportation from Bamfield or Toquart Bay (soon to open again) for $90, including the kayak. Find the rates here. The MV Frances Barkley also arrives and unloads kayaks or canoes at the dock in front of Broken Islands Lodge but is cancelled for 2021.

properties.Title: Raynor Islands south
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate gradient sand beach at low water, cobble above. Scattered boulders. N aspect. Beach wraps around W side of island, also to NE side. Exposed to NW but in lee of other islands. Protected from SE. One side or other should be protected in most conditions.
properties.Camp Comments: Access upland at hung float. 4+ open forest clear tent sites. Hammock opportunities. Beach sites reported, but none seen that has tidal clearance.
properties.Other Comments: None.

properties.Title: Okeover Arm Tuxwnech
properties.Landing Comments: Easy access on shallow steps from parking area, walk-in sites to rough low gradient beach with scattered boulders. E aspect. Close to Okeover public harbour.
properties.Camp Comments: 14 vehicle access sites, 2 double sites, 4 walk-in sites open seasonally. 4 smaller walk-in sites open all year. Light forest.
properties.Other Comments: Water at tap. Swimming. 4 ha park. Overnight pay parking nearby if leaving campsite. See: Okeover Arm Provincial Park

properties.Title: Chop Bay west
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient clam bed beach with pebble, scattered boulders in protected bay. Expect long carry at low water. SE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites in second growth forest.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive.

properties.Title: Henrietta Island
properties.Landing Comments: Protected beach clam bed beach, moderate gradient, with pebble, cobble, scattered boulders. Rougher at top.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites subject to brushing on small plateau where slope behind beach flattens. Little undergrowth. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Baronet Passage east
properties.Landing Comments: Rough beach of gravel at high water but boulders at lower water levels. Clam bed below.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites in level, open forest with minor brushing. Beach top tent sites on gravel feasible at most tides.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Baronet Passage north
properties.Landing Comments: Large protected bay with broad clam bed beach. Moderate to low gradient. Cobble, some boulders. Long carry at low water, so use at high water suggested. S aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach top tent sites on gravel will be dry at most tides. Level second growth forest could take 2-4 additional tents with brushing, clearing of minor branches. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Spacious. Stream mapped at centre bay but not seen 2023.

properties.Title: Grassy Island Plumper Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Land on exposed rock ledges. NW shore preferred. Strong currents.
properties.Camp Comments: Exposed sites on rock lacking shade.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. See Cormorant Channel Marine Park.

properties.Title: Claydon Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Protected beach of cobble, rubble, scattered boulders. Few drift logs. At low water likely low gradient clam bed, 200 m long carry. SE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites on grass banks or in jumbled second growth forest. Many additional sites if brushed or deadfall removed. Hammock opportunities. Some areas damp where tributaries enter main stream.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round stream. Remains of large wharf. Large 142 Ha. Provincial Recreation Site. Anchorage.

properties.Title: Little Flower Islet
properties.Landing Comments: Protected tiny coves of gravel, bedrock, mussels, cobble on either side of isthmus between Hutt Island and islet. Low water landing easier. Challenging at high water on steep sloping bedrock. Exposed to wind, swell.
properties.Camp Comments: Fragile grassy, mossy upland areas in tiny arbutus grove. No fires. Picnic table (2017)
properties.Other Comments: View. Attractive. Google names islet Hart Island (Formerly Passarini).

properties.Title: Olivia Islet
properties.Landing Comments: Land at boulder gully on steep NE shore of islet.
properties.Camp Comments: Up gully to right are small flat spots in trees, tall salal. Brushing likely needed. Short carry.
properties.Other Comments: Better suited to lined out boat rather than canoe or kayak due to awkward land stowage for portable boats.

properties.Title: Anvils Foot
properties.Landing Comments: Difficult on gently sloping smooth bedrock shelf at high water in tiny cove, some exposure to winds, swells.  Shelf may carry stream drainage in wet weather. Unknown landing at low water. NE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Potential for several tents in upland light forest, salal on gentle slopes. Steeper slopes immediately behind lower area.
properties.Other Comments: Unlikely haven on inhospitable shore. Water at seasonal creeks. Benches also exist to N & S where determined paddlers could land on bedrock ledges to possibly camp on a bluff.

properties.Title: Montagu Channel east
properties.Landing Comments: Steep beach 15-20 % slope, sharp 75 mm gravel at all water levels in small cove. NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: 2 undeveloped upland sites on grass among small trees, one additional site possibly on bluff.
properties.Other Comments: Awkward 4 m climb to upland bluff. Trains run infrequently on track immediately above. No highway access.

properties.Title: Maggy Point
properties.Landing Comments: Easy in bay N of Rough Islets. SW aspect. Pebble, gravel beach, with cobbles, boulders at sides. Moderate gradient. Protected from N, E, SE. Currents to 3 kt in Swanson Passage.
properties.Camp Comments: Sites in forest. Pole shed kitchen shelter in need of minor roof repair 2023. Camp furniture. 5 tent platforms, new 2025. Food bin. Composting toilet.
properties.Other Comments: Former commercial site. Short trail to nearby Rough Islets site. Wildlife viewing. See Broughton Archipelago Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Brem Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient beach of mud, 50 - 70 mm rocks leading to grassy estuary wetland. Might be island.
properties.Camp Comments: Clearing under trees for several tents at wetland margin. More sites feasible with brushing. Coordinates given as N50D 26.026M,W124D 40.408M
properties.Other Comments: Water at river. Salmon Bay Indian Reserve lies immediately W. N Frazer suggests camping 150 m S near the breakwater by the log dump. It at W end of beach to E of breakwater. Comment that carry over mud is too far at this side and easier by jetty, on NE corner but in IR.

properties.Title: Deep Bay Jedediah Island
properties.Landing Comments: Steep shoreline at cove head. Small rough beach. Sheltered. Often used by boaters with tenders. Little boat stowage room ashore.
properties.Camp Comments: Dispersed camping permitted. Nearest to bay, sloped sites under trees adjacent to pit toilet 50 m above landing. Camping fees apply 15 May to 15 September. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2024) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System. Better camping located at Log Boom Bay approx 400 m along trail but that location unsanctioned by BC Parks.
properties.Other Comments: Popular anchorage with stern tie rings. Extensive hiking trails. See Jedediah Island Provincial Marine Park

properties.Title: Lady Ellen Point
properties.Landing Comments: Gravel, sand, pebble beach, moderately steep. A few drift logs. Exposed NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Sites in level forest. Old tarp camp seen 2023 to W of point, possibly same long term squat seen in 2002, presumably using trail/road access.
properties.Other Comments: Mapped trail access on Lady Ellen Point Trail, branching from Ledge Point Main, likely de-activated industrial roads. From shore estimated 10 min walk to road.

properties.Title: Sir Thomas Lipton
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient beach of sand, silt, pebble, small rocks at head of sheltered West Bay. S aspect. Land near creek mouth, large sign visible from water.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped sites along shore or in open forest. Some close to large painted sign facing seaward, others further E. Pit toilet adjacent to graded gravel access road leading to New Brighton. Rough connecting trails involve minor creek crossing. No fires permitted, but one fire pit remains. Deadfall reported on some potential tenting areas. Avoid camping under deciduous trees especially broadleaf maples.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Year-round water at McDonald (or MacDonald) Creek or tributary 'Butcher Brook'. Small waterfall. Historic shipwreck. Sunshine Coast Regional District Park. Derelict dock washed up on beach. Road access no longer requires crossing gated private land (2022). Observe Rockfish Conservation Area in West Bay - no angling.

properties.Title: Logan Creek
properties.Landing Comments: At water levels of 1.7 m or higher moderate but safe landing on rocky beach protected by reef. More difficult at lower water levels.
properties.Camp Comments: Established but unattractive campsite. Better suited for day use. Fees charged. Better alternative is Cullite Creek 1.3 NM to SW
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. Used by hikers on West Coast Trail. Landing or camping on the West Coast Trail is not permitted and could result in fines, except in emergency situations.

properties.Title: Poett Nook Campground
properties.Landing Comments: See adjacent launch site information
properties.Camp Comments: Developed drive-in commercial campground. 130 sites. Showers, toilets. Camping $53.55 includes power (2021) for 4 people http://www.poettnook.com/welcome.html

properties.Title: Rondeault Point
properties.Landing Comments: Sand beach at low tide, pea gravel with sand in mid band, pea gravel and pebble at high water. Protected NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Many tent sites on sand beach. Protected from S and partially from W. Reported June 2024 that a No Trespassing sign has been posted in upland. Park boundary is winter high water mark - above that is private land.
properties.Other Comments: Views. See: Maquinna Marine Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Camper Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Moderately steep pebble beach in cove. SW aspect. Swell hits main beach to give dumping wave in heavy swell conditions. NW beach has less or no swell due to protecting reef at cove entrance, depending on water level. Turn left or NW on entering cove if reef is blocking most swell.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp at top of NW beach but not at all tide levels. Cliff behind give no easy upland access. Park fees apply. Might be feasible to carry gear to West Coast hiking trail campsite across lagoon at back of main beach to avoid being flooded at Springs.
properties.Other Comments: Seasonal cabin normally staffed by local Pacheedaht trail guardians. AKA Camper Creek. Landing or camping on the West Coast Trail is not permitted and could result in fines, except in emergency situations.

properties.Title: Cullite Creek
properties.Landing Comments: In low swell, easy on sloped sand, pebble beach, with S aspect, mostly protected from W, NW.  Some surf likely in high swell conditions. To avoid scattered rock outcrops or boulders, aim for E side about 10 -15 m from base of steep cliff. See image for route.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites under trees or on gravel creek bank. Food storage bin. Pit toilet. Fees charged.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. Used by hikers on West Coast Trail.

properties.Title: Billygoat Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Steep shingle beach; right channel (S) is a funnel too narrow for access in any swell; far left (N) best landing in NW swell.
properties.Camp Comments: Possible camping.
properties.Other Comments: Pacific Rim National Park Reserve. Landing or camping on the West Coast Trail is not permitted and could result in fines, except in emergency situations.

properties.Title: Tsuquanah Point northwest
properties.Landing Comments: Somewhat protected, fairly steep pocket beach. Surf may dump. Watch for rocks at NW end of beach. Beware of severe turbulence, standing waves, rips, breakers off Nitinat Bar especially when Nitinat Lake (tidal) drains seaward on ebb.
properties.Camp Comments: Camping not currently sanctioned by Parks Canada but might occur. Space for 5 or more tents on beach.
properties.Other Comments: Water at small stream. Secluded. In Pacific Rim National Park Reserve. Landing or camping on the West Coast Trail is not permitted and could result in fines, except in emergency situations.

properties.Title: Meade Islets
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand on W side of islet at high water only. Cobble, weed, long carry at mid, low water. Easier approach from E, on steep cobble beach.
properties.Camp Comments: 3 or tide-dependent variable number of sites on sand tombolo between drift logs. Upland site reported at centre of islet but not found (2017). Dense upland vegetation.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. No fires above high water.

properties.Title: Robinson Island Barkley Sound
properties.Landing Comments: Easy approach on low gradient sand beach at all water levels. N aspect. Protected by rock reefs to N, E from swell, wind.
properties.Camp Comments: 3 upland sites on strip above beach. 2 further upland sites feasible with minor brushing, levelling. Island at back of bay looks flat, may have potential for group camping.
properties.Other Comments: Water possible at seasonal creek 0.3 NM to N behind point. Site may be accessed at high water in any weather via narrow channel to Julia Passage.

properties.Title: Macktush Bill Motyka Recreation Site
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on concrete boat ramp, gravel boat ramp and various beaches. 2 lagoons.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed site for vehicle based camping. Pit toilets, playground, hot showers, store. Fees charged. Reservations.
properties.Other Comments: Large campsite, launch used by sports fishers. Site is 30 km drive from Port Alberni along Canal Main. which also goes by Arden Creek. Near confluence of Macktush Creek and Alberni Inlet. Water at taps. Campsite located on Mosaic Forest Management land, managed by Silvifor Resource Consultants Ltd.

properties.Title: Arden Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Primitive boat launch.
properties.Camp Comments: 2 pleasant walk-in pads overlooking water up steep paths and 4 vehicle pads in trees or along shoreline. Picnic tables, toilets.
properties.Other Comments: Also launch site. Water at creek. Site 17.5 km along Canal Main. No fees charged (2014). Operated by Hupacasath First Nation.

properties.Title: Homfray Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Mixed low gradient beach of gravel with some boulders at higher water levels, rougher at lower levels with an oyster band. W aspect. Protected from S but otherwise exposed.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland forest sites would need brushing, Alternative camp on old roadbed about 250 m N of main site with access from main creek, past large boulders. Area S of creek has grassy sections. Trail leads into upland. Report of difficult access to tenting area (July 2023) with no beach camping evident seems to refer to site to N of creek. 'Little to no boat storage at high water without difficult lift over large boulders. Our team used the floating dock for kayak storage and camped on old road bed.' Better camping area is S of creek.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round creek. View. Active log dump at head of bay 350 m to N of site. Logged behind.

properties.Title: Lloyd Point
properties.Land Tenure: Crown tenure - Section 17 designated use area, Provincial Forest
properties.Landing Comments: Mixed low gradient beach of cobble with some boulders. SW aspect. Protected from N.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland sites require brushing in level open forest. Possible sites among rocks in grassy open area at top of beach. 180 m to S at small creek additional upland forest sites reported suited to large group.
properties.Other Comments: View. Water at Lloyd Creek to N with uncertain access along shore. Logged behind. Seasonal creek 180 m to SE.

properties.Title: Teakerne Head
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on long beach of large pebble. W aspect. Moderately protected from most winds.
properties.Camp Comments: 1 secluded site behind old machinery float immediately usable. 2 or 3 other level forested sires at shore margin usable with light brushing.
properties.Other Comments: Quiet. Log handling site nearby to N appears inactive. Old donkey engine float (2005), fruit trees. Swimming. Popular anchorage.

properties.Title: Jamieson Island central
properties.Landing Comments: Clam bed beach of varying gradients in bay, well-protected from W.   Gravel upper beach. A few small boulders. SE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Grassy gravel bench at beach top will be dry in most tides. Usable tent site if small drift log debris, small rocks were moved. Hammock opportunities. Dense vegetation in upland.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive.

properties.Title: Zorro Bay Ts’itpsm
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on wide gravel beach, sheltered except from N. Moderate gradient. NE aspect. Land to N of wharf, boathouse. Drift logs often on beach. Prominent sign visible from water. Alternate more exposed beach of small round stones usable during outflows with good shelter from N across neck of isthmus. Faces S. Possible to carry gear to site 110 m across neck of isthmus on good trail across gated private land for safer access.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland sites in mixed woods up trail behind centre beach. 1 site at beach top on pebble. 6 tent platforms, 2 accessed on N side of bay up wooden stair. Composting toilet. Steel food bin. Beach fire pit. Fire bucket. 2 Picnic tables, Visitor log book.
properties.Other Comments: Water at stream with boat access only 200 m N. View. Swimming. Overlooked by derelict cabin on private peninsula. Boathouse, derelict wharf nearby. Please respect all private property. Squamish (Coast Salish) name Ts’itpsm. Site stewards Sea Kayak Assn of BC. Site is often used by visitors in powered vessels as well as in paddlecraft. Squamish Yacht Club mooring buoy in outer bay.

properties.Title: Tantalus Landing Sxwan’shnm
properties.Landing Comments: Semi-cleared boat run through rough boulder, bedrock shore 40 m W of creek mouth, or at high water, moderate landing at creek mouth on boulders, bedrock ledges. S aspect. 10% slope or greater, some portions gravel, varied 100 mm cobble. Prone to drift logs.  Prominent sign visible from water. Very limited portable boat stowage unless boats carried up bank.
properties.Camp Comments: Steps lead up bank across footbridge crossing creek to upland sites at 3 small level flats near shore or 3 wooden platforms built on steep slopes above. Composting toilet. Steel food bin near landing, large picnic table built on old industrial concrete footing to be shared by all site users. Visitor log book. Please restrict any fires to near-level open rock slab near NE shore in calm conditions.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round stream, waterfall through centre of site. Attractive. View. Squamish (Coast Salish) name Sxwan’shnm. Site stewards: Sea Kayak Assn of BC.

properties.Title: Booker Lagoon
properties.Landing Comments: Islet 35 m long oriented SW to NE in sheltered lagoon. Approach at NW side, NE end. Rock shelf, no beach. Tidal rapid at lagoon entrance. Max current in rapid reported as 8 kn.
properties.Camp Comments: Grassy saddle in mid islet with firs at either end. This location or slightly to S at end of islet used by Paddlefanatics group May 2014, who also checked other locations. Well protected. N Frazer gives coordinates as lat N50D 47.50M,W126D 44.98M (WGS84) which seems to be the same general site. Adjacent islet in similar orientation but slightly to W is apparently not the site.
properties.Other Comments: Swimming from landing ledges.

properties.Title: George Fraser Islands north
properties.Landing Comments: Beach of pebble, boulders at low water, sand, gravel mid to high water.  Easier at higher water.  Protected from NW, but overall exposed location.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach camping
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Finnerty Islands central
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected gravel, small rock beach. NE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: One site on gravel berm or tombolo at head of beach, 2 or 3 others upland in juniper, arbutus grove.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Lagoons. Charted height 48 m on some CHS charts. See Sabine Channel Marine Provincial Park

properties.Title: Philip Point west
properties.Landing Comments: Protected creek mouth behind islet has clam bed moderate gradient beach of coarse sand, gravel with 50-70 mm cobble, occasional boulders. Beach grass on upper beach covers more cobble, rocks. Firm clam bed with some cobble st low water. Few drift logs. W aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland tent sites on S bank in open second growth forest. Shaded in morning but open to afternoon sun. Berry bushes impede access to upland. Access would need brushing.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water at creek, possibly year-round. Flowing in mid-July drought 2023. Attractive. View. Logging debris. Inactive log dump 0.6 NM to E (2023).

properties.Title: Hannant Peninsula
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on protected smooth bedrock. Protected boulder cove to E dries, but likely suitable at high water.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent site on dry beach grass at point. Other sites nearby on rock shelves. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive, view, sunny. Water across bay at Little McIntosh Creek. Anchorage in cove N of Hannant Point.

properties.Title: Boyle Point northwest
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on semi-protected pebble beach of moderate gradient 0.2 NM W of Boyle Point. Scattered boulders. S aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Sunny beach sites or on grassy former homestead site. Large level upland bench slightly higher. Rest of upland steep. Mostly used by day visitors.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Seasonal stream. aka Betty's Beach, Diane's Beach. Rough steep trail leads in 1.5 km to main trail back to parking lot at end of East Road. Other extensive trails.

properties.Title: Atchison Islet
properties.Landing Comments: Land in drying channel between island, islet or on various rock ledges, depending on water level. Suitable for lining out boat. Easier access at high water, many boulders at low water. Currents. Kelp. Vessel traffic.
properties.Camp Comments: Flat rock ledge facing S tip of Atchison Island or bluff sites on bedrock shelves at SW tip. Dense salal in centre.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View.

properties.Title: Turner Cove
properties.Landing Comments: W or E shore of protected cove. On W shore, moderately sloped clam bed mud beach with mixed rocks, gravel at high water. One area  next to a large rock outcrop on the beach free of low water boulders. Beach may flood at springs.
properties.Camp Comments: On W shore at N50D 55.683M,W126D 43.925M beach gives access to upland that appears fairly level but dense, mossy forest with old logging surface disturbance. On E shore, grassy point could be brushed but might be too steep for easy camping. Either area requires work.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive.

properties.Title: Mackenzie Sound 1
properties.Landing Comments: Steep rock shore with patch of grass on top lies half way into creek mouth. Bay overall shallow clam beds with low gradient.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland forest camp on N shore of cove has old poles but not very level (1999). Not viewed on 2015 visit. Sunny.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek.

properties.Title: Stuart Narrows north
properties.Landing Comments: Clam bed beach, pebble gravel.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites in second growth forest with little underbrush if dead branches, tree debris moved. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round stream flowing during drought of mid-July2023.

properties.Title: Helen Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Small pebble, gravel, small rock beach in W bay. Moderate gradient. Protected. Forest comes to waterline.
properties.Camp Comments: Usable small tent sites in forest on moss, duff needing dead branches moved. Clearing in cedar trees above beach may require brushing, levelling. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal stream, dry July 2023. Anchorage. Flagging evident 2023 could relate to stream or intended logging? Junk freezer in bush. Debris. Might be old logging camp.

properties.Title: Deep Harbour north
properties.Landing Comments: Small moderate gradient pebble beach in bight. Scattered cobble, boulders. Forest comes down to waterline. No distinctive landmark. SW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites in second growth forest on flat area 2-3 m up bank behind beach. Upland steep at sides.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Small anchorage.

properties.Title: Joe Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Shell tombolo which joins to steep islet. 2 small very protected beaches with N, S aspects. Moderate gradient. Occasional boulders.
properties.Camp Comments: Many well-used all-weather upland tent sites on duff, bare soil. Rustic furniture.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water source reported at lake-fed stream in unnamed cove W of Joe Cove, assumed to be N 50 D 44.5818M, W126 D 41.6874 M. Commercial group use likely. Anchorage. Upland in Broughton Archipelago Conservancy. Waters, islets lie in Marine Provincial Park.

properties.Title: Bain Creek Smenmántm Ḵ’í ḵp’ikw
properties.Landing Comments: 2 small rocky beaches. S aspect. Moderate gradient curved cleared boat run of smaller rocks at N margin of creek mouth 50 m to E of prominent main sign facing water. Some boulders, bedrock.  Another narrower rough boat run through beach next to sign requires climbing on steps, hauling boats up bank. Frequent boulders elsewhere on main beaches. Limited area at high water. Alternate landing area 50 m to W of sign at W end of site on gravel with 100 mm rounded rocks at high water, but currently has poor upland access. Easiest boat stowage, best access on rack above E'most beach.
properties.Camp Comments: Large shaded site. Several tent sites just E of main landing in upland forest SW of stream. S aspect. - several other sites higher up slope to SW. Hammock opportunities. Composting toilet up trail via steps. Steel food bin. Picnic table. Boat rack. Visitor log book. Fire bucket. Sunny bluff for picnics. No fires in upland.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Small waterfall. View. Attractive except Port Mellon mill visible, audible. Prominent sign visible from water. Squamish (Coast Salish) name Smenmántm Ḵ’í ḵp’ikw. Charted creek named Bain Ck is elsewhere. This creek is unnamed - maybe should be Bain Creek #2. Site stewards: Sea Kayak Assn of BC.

properties.Title: Cook Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Easy in either of 2 coves with beaches of pebble, cobble with aspects generally N (NE, N)  Protected from SE, NW. Mostly floods at high water. Some riprap banks. SE cove gives easier upland access.
properties.Camp Comments: Industrial site suited to emergency use only. Two semi-sandy tent sites at Neaps high water mark that likely will flood at tides above 3.3 m. One potential uneven upland site in forest. BC Hydro Transmission line nearby with grassed area, prominent cable sign. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek. Power transmission line right of way nearby. Road at nearby Jonathan Road, BC Hydro Utility Access Road leading to Porlier Pass Road.

properties.Title: Twin Beaches
properties.Landing Comments: Beach of small cobbles. SE aspect. Optional landing on similar but smaller beach on opposite side of neck. W aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp on grassy ridge 15+ m elevation in open, level pine, fir forest. Steep obvious approach up open grass slope. Hammock opportunities. Undeveloped. 2 tent sites on grass, Additional sites to W may need light brushing of brambles, holly.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View.

properties.Title: Jamieson Island west
properties.Landing Comments: Beaches on N, S  of dying channel between islets give access to small clear bank areas. Gravel, clam shell, cobble, bedrock beach. Rougher on N side. SE or N aspects. Some boulders. Small lagoon on N side.
properties.Camp Comments: 3-4 tent sites on grassy patches at forest margin. I site on bluff. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: unknown

properties.Title: George Fraser Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Beach of pebble, boulders at low water, sand, gravel mid to high water.  Easier at higher water.  Protected from NW, but overall exposed location.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach camping.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Fleming Island Lagoon
properties.Landing Comments: Shallow lagoon, with reef/rocks. Sand, gravel beach. It's actually difficult to find. The lagoon itself and the entrance are not readily visible as the entrance is hidden behind the rock reef. On more exposed NW side of island. Access easy at high water but awkward due to extensive mud at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Camp in upland - two locations. Stinging nettles at one of sites.
properties.Other Comments: Pleasant, protected site but avoid low water.

properties.Title: Frances Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate landing on beach of pebbles, large cobbles, some boulders. Exposed to S. Boat run. (not found at last site condition report) but likely nearby.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped beach camping between drift logs. 2 brushed upland sites (2023). Large level ground in upland, room for a few tents. Brushing would help. Other former tent sites on old roadway overgrown, unusable. Hammock opportunities for about 3 people. Beware of hazard trees.
properties.Other Comments: View. Old industrial roads. Inactive log dump.

properties.Title: Pachena Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Large low gradient sand beach. SW aspect. Surf depends on swell direction.  Length of bay usually offers some shelter.
properties.Camp Comments: Developed commercial campground. Set up mainly for RVs. Beachfront sites at forest edge. Hot showers, flush toilets, sani-dump. Open May-September. Limited off-season camping begins on March 1 for self-contained units only - main washroom/shower house remains closed until May. Reservations: (250) 728-1287 Email: Info@PachenaBayCampground.ca Web: https://pachenabaycampground.ca/beachfront-rv-and-tenting-sites/
properties.Other Comments: Location next to Huu-ay-aht First Nation community of Anacla. Bamfield 5 km. West Coast hiking Trail trailhead nearby. Owned and operated by Huu-ay-aht First Nation. Attractive beach, river, wildlife viewing.

properties.Title: Bonner Islet east
properties.Landing Comments: Protected, but surf possible on 2.5m or higher tides.
properties.Camp Comments: Some beach sites at most tide levels but uncertain if usable at Springs. More wind protection than at W beach site.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. Trail to W beach for viewing sea state.

properties.Title: Restless Mountain
properties.Landing Comments: Sand, gravel beach moderate gradient with steeper gravel sections. SE aspect. W side has more protection from surf. in lee of reefs,rock outcrops.  All sand to mid water, gravel at high water.  At centre beach heavy surf possible. Scattered rocks, boulders with clear sections.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Beach sites near forest edge, .One established tent site. No cleared upland sites. Two other sites between creeks. Sand, gravel sites may need minor leveling.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal streams crossing beach, Attractive. See Lawn Point Provincial Park

properties.Title: Denham Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Beach or float dock in semi-protected bay.
properties.Camp Comments: No known camping - summer fishing resort has 4 rental cabins. Open approx May - September. Managers: Peter Geneau, Sarah Askwith. Peter: 250-703-6978 or Sarah: 250-218-8538 denhamdocks@gmail.com
properties.Other Comments: For emergency use only, unless pre-booked.

properties.Title: Dent Island Lodge
properties.Landing Comments: Rough beaches, float docks. Vessel traffic, strong currents. Drying rapid, rocky channel adjacent to Lodge. Access possible from NW or SE sides but SE side more protected.
properties.Camp Comments: Resort fishing lodge open June - September. Pre-booking required for all stays. Call 250-203-2553.
properties.Other Comments: Listed for emergency use only. For emergency use only, unless pre-booked.

properties.Title: Espinosa Inlet north
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on moderately steep pebble beach. Suited to all water levels, all-weather. NW aspect offering some protection from wind, swell.
properties.Camp Comments: Small upland tent sites along short trail, 3-4 hammocks hangs, at S corner of beach. Potential for 3 more upland sites with minor work, plus beach sites if pebbles levelled. May be harder to access at Springs, but will be dry.
properties.Other Comments: Inactive log dump with old roads behind. Better than Espinosa Inlet site to S.

properties.Title: Abrams middle beach
properties.Landing Comments: Well protected narrow rocky cove ends in low gradient sand, grit beach. Pebble above. Many drift logs. 2 all-tide channels, one channel navigable only at high water. S aspect. Boomers, kelp. Vessel traffic outside.
properties.Camp Comments: 2 tent sites at a distance SE from high water landing. Additional sites if brushed. Scramble over rocks around headland. Hammock opportunities. Beach camping potential at Neaps. Deadfall hazards.
properties.Other Comments: Might be former village site. See Vargas Island Provincial Park. We have created a Vargas Island webpage with additional information.

properties.Title: Goletas Waterfall
properties.Landing Comments: In cove with NE aspect. Easy on moderate gradient beach of angular cobble, rocks to 200 mm, scattered boulders. Watch for larger submerged rocks at low tide, uncovered rocks are very slippery. Pebble above. Protected from all directions except NE. Lesser gradient on lower beach makes for long carry at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: All-tide beach camping on pebble. Summer Springs to 5.0 m leave small beach area. Upland sites also possible with brushing. Potential for hammock use.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round creek, waterfall, pool. Attractive. View.

properties.Title: Mels Beach Vargas Island
properties.Landing Comments: Broad low gradient exposed sand beach. NW aspect. Expect less surf & swell or none to W where island blocks wrapping.
properties.Camp Comments: Dispersed beach sites except at highest Springs. At Springs, favour nearby Dick and Jane Beach. Green throne toilet.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Some private land, cabin at N end of bay with signage. See Vargas Island Provincial Park. See Vargas Island webpage with information on Ahousaht access passes.A short access trail to Dick and Jane's Beach and at low tides makes it possible to walk to Secret Beach on the sand. From Secret Beach there is a trail that takes one all the way to Surfers and Fingers beaches. The landing at the eastern end of Mel's Beach is protected by a tombolo at low tides.

properties.Title: Alder Bay Resort
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on sand, gravel beach, float or concrete ramp. NNW aspect. Protected by breakwater.
properties.Camp Comments: Large oceanside RV park with tent sites. Full service RV park. Tents welcome. Water, flush toilets, showers, laundry, food truck restaurant. Phone: 1-250-956-4117 Email: stay@alderbay.com
properties.Other Comments: From Hwy #19 turn right onto Beaver Cove Road. Entrance 6km on left. Alder Bay RV Park & Marina, PO Box 1090 Port McNeill, BC, V0N 2R0. Double concrete boat ramp. Floats. Vehicles may be parked for $5.00/day fee.

properties.Title: Favada Cobble Beach
properties.Landing Comments: Cobble, boulder beach runs at angle behind rock outcrop. Little protection from swells. Close to cliffs on N. Beach floods at Springs.
properties.Camp Comments: 2 small upland sites, if lightly brushed. Better sites than at Favada Point south.
properties.Other Comments: Marginal site overall.

properties.Title: Favada Point Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Angular cobbles, boulders with pebbles at top on beach of S aspect. Moderately steep. Drift logs. Protected except from S. Could be hazardous in strong S wind, swell.
properties.Camp Comments: Grassy upland sites on headland to W. Hammock opportunities. Ruined cabin.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. More capacity than neighbouring sites. Flagging suggests trail leading to Crescent Bay Road or to stream entering Maple Bay to N.

properties.Title: Laura Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient exposed sand beach. Bands of rocks at lower tides. Subject to NW swell, winds, surf lacking protection.
properties.Camp Comments: 4 tent platforms, food cache, pit toilet approximately 200 m W of creek on N Coast hiking trail. 1 or more beach sites on sand.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek. On N Coast hiking trail. Landing here is potentially hazardous.

properties.Title: Cox Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Exposed sweeping low gradient sand beach. W aspect. Heavier, more consistent surf than nearby beaches in swells except from S.  Headland at S end offers more protection. Landing not advised in winter or in swells over 1 m. Vessel traffic. Beware of surfers.
properties.Camp Comments: Bookable private commercial campsites e.g. Long Beach Lodge Resort, Cox Bay Beach Resort, Pacific Sands Beach Resort.
properties.Other Comments: Tidepools. Parking at public lot accessed by entrance to Long Beach Lodge Resort. Also on Maltby Road.

properties.Title: Sharp Creek
properties.Landing Comments: Very low gradient mud flat dries to sedge bank. Easiest at high water. At lower water, prefer  approach from N.  NW aspect. Winds funnel in Lemmens Inlet. Obvious opening in forest canopy at creek exit.
properties.Camp Comments: Upland sites in forest clearing behind sedge directly up from landing. Camping on sedge or grass feasible at neaps. Pay attention to good sanitation, food protection - practice the Marine Trails Code of Conduct.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal creek running through site.

properties.Title: Raynor Islands central beach
properties.Landing Comments: Large protected low gradient sand, clam bed beach. Rock islets. Scattered boulders, bedrock outcrops. Long carry at low water. N aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: 2 beach top sites on grass, rocks. 1 site on flat rock outcrop. Other potential sites lack tidal clearance. Relatively easy upland access makes additional sites feasible with brushing. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Popplewell Cove
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate gradient beach of boulders, cobble, sand in semi-protected cove. Grassy upland margin. SE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Protected tent sites in level second growth forest will need dead branches removed but no significant underbrush.
properties.Other Comments: Water at year-round stream crossing beach, flowing in drought mid-July 2023.

properties.Title: Wehlis Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Clam bed beach with boulders, cobble at most water levels. Some sand, grassy patches. Large open bay. Drift log accumulation. SE aspect. Open to wind.
properties.Camp Comments: Undeveloped. Tent sites in level second growth forest on N side of bay, if dead branches moved, but little underbrush. Various grass patches lumpy or boulder-strewn. Beach sites limited by drift log mass.
properties.Other Comments: Water at 2 seasonal streams crossing beach at corners.

properties.Title: Browning Islands
properties.Landing Comments: Moderate gradient cobble beach in small bay. Protected from NW but exposed to E. E aspect. Drift logs make beach access more awkward at high water.
properties.Camp Comments: 1 potential tent site. At least 2 easy hammock sites. Lumpy, rough terrain, beach.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Cook Island south
properties.Landing Comments: Large clam bed lies behind rocks. Cobble, boulders. SE aspect. Alternative access from low gradient clam bed on other side of neck. NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Small bluffs areas offer possible sites. Dense salal. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Wells Passage west
properties.Landing Comments: Clam bed at low water. Cobble, boulder at high water. Exposed to wind from several directions. SE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach top sites on cobble possible at Neaps. Dense upland vegetation. Possible hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Water at seasonal stream.

properties.Title: OBrien Bay north
properties.Landing Comments: Sheltered smooth rock ledges or adjacent small cove with cobble, boulders. NE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites on grass at most tides.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View.

properties.Title: Daedalus Peninsula
properties.Landing Comments: Relatively smooth cobble, boulder, beach in double bay with additional bay across rocky neck. Moderate gradient. E aspect. Protected except from NE.
properties.Camp Comments: Small beach-top site good for most tides. Marked trail with rope for assistance up bank, leading to rustic bench. I upland site off trail. Potential for more sites with brushing. Hammock opprtunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Wildlife viewing. Tex Lyon hiking trail runs nearby. Water source at head of bay immediately to S i.e. Basket Eaters Bay. Some confusion in naming, identity of sites. Official name, if any, unknown.

properties.Title: Kutcous Point
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient sand beach, steeper at top. Spit to island reef creates heavier wave, surf than elsewhere. Avoid landing at main beach in heavy swell. Alternative landing in cove to E of main beach more protected but longer carry.
properties.Camp Comments: 25+ sites on beach camping except during winter storms. Some scattered upland forest sites. Toilet. Bear cache.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. View. Water at river at NW corner but go far upstream for fresh water. Part of Wild Side hiking trail.

properties.Title: Fingers
properties.Landing Comments: Coves between rock fingers protect sand beaches from dominant NW winds, surf. SE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach sites on sand. Composting toilet. Animal-resistant food cache. Hammock opportunities. Amazing site. Obviously popular so difficult to get a good site in peak summer
properties.Other Comments: Also known as Little Baja. Short trail 300 m to large beach with W aspect known as Surfers' Beach. Water at creek at centre of main bay 1.5 km. Hiking trail across S Vargas I. See Vargas Island Provincial Park. See Vargas Island webpage with information on Ahousaht access passes.

properties.Title: Cow Bay west 2
properties.Landing Comments: Broad sand beach of moderately low gradient. SE aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach sites on sand among drift logs.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water sources at Cow Bay west, approx 500 m to W.

properties.Title: Popplewell Point north
properties.Landing Comments: Clam bed beach at low water. Sand, silt or mud, pebble. Boulders at high water. Moderate gradient. Protected from S,W. E aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Beach top site at Neaps. Grassy at forest margin. Brushing likely needed. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Water at seasonal stream but Popplewell Cove 0.3 NM to SW more reliable source.

properties.Title: Ahous Bay south
properties.Landing Comments: S end of overall large bay usually more protected, may be calm. Hook at S corner gives more shelter.
properties.Camp Comments: Entire expansive sand beach suited to camping. Random wilderness camping allowed. Please use animal-proof food bins at N and S ends of bay. New fully enclosed outhouse 2024. Kitchen pole structure for hanging a group tarp.
properties.Other Comments: Water at creek in centre bay. Attractive long sandy beach. Hiking trail across S Vargas I. See Vargas Island Provincial Park. See Vargas Island webpage with information on Ahousaht access passes. Link to the Ahousaht map showing where camping or day use allowed.

properties.Title: Chetarpe
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient sand beach, usable at all water levels. Small surf possible. Point at S offers protection. Beach generally floods. Marine traffic hazards. Hazards off Chetarpe Point in S approach to beach.
properties.Camp Comments: Tent sites at 2 current (2024) clearings under willow trees. Some potential for hammocks, but most trees small.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Sunny. Water at seasonal stream.

properties.Title: Atleo River
properties.Landing Comments: Easy on gravel beach. W aspect. Protected from S, open to N. Vessel traffic. Frequent high afternoon winds.
properties.Camp Comments: 4-5 tent sites in W-facing open forest clearings. Rustic site requiring more site levelling work. 2-3 additional beach tent sites to N. MHSS Stewardship Fee (Ahousaht First Nation) required to camp.
properties.Other Comments: Attractive. Year-round water at Atleo R approx. 600 m to S.. On paddling route to Mux̣šiƛa Hot Springs at Nism̓aakqin. Refer to FN Info box for payment of stewardship fee.

properties.Title: Deserters Islet
properties.Landing Comments: Protected beach of bedrock, small boulders in channel between islands. All-tide. S aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Walk across rocks to small grass patch for 1-2 small tents. Sheltered except from S. Short carry. Small, easily used site.
properties.Other Comments: Lift boats up rocks to store ashore. See Mahpahkum-Ahkwuna/Deserters-Walker Conservancy.

properties.Title: Deserters Meadow
properties.Landing Comments: In protected cove, low gradient sand, mud clam bed beach. Scattered boulders. Gravel at high water. NW aspect. Much rougher alternative landing on E (outer) shore.
properties.Camp Comments: 5 or more tent sites in small meadow. Short trail up bank from beach via awkward step. Small gravel beach top sites for additional 3 tents, dry at 4.5 m tides but marginal at 4.8 m. Ensure to minimize your impact on sensitive wildflowers.
properties.Other Comments: View. See Mahpahkum-Ahkwuna/Deserters-Walker Conservancy.

properties.Title: Tomlinson Point south
properties.Landing Comments: Large low gradient sandy clam bed beach. Steeper at beach top. More rocky at sides. Exposed to SW but mostly protected from NW, SE. Some upper beach remains dry at Neaps, but Springs might flood it entirely. Long carry at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: Up to 10 beach top sites under trees on sand appear to be dry most tides. Easy upland access to approx. 3 additional small tent sites requiring brushing. Hammock opportunities.
properties.Other Comments: No comments.

properties.Title: Staples Island northwest
properties.Landing Comments: Protected low gradient clam bed beach. Mud at low water, boulders, cobble at mid, higher water levels. Visible grass mostly floods. Long carry at low water. Old boat run visible at mid, high water. N aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: 1 tent site on gravel beach top clear of tidal challenges, 2 possible additional sites upland w much brushing of vegetation.
properties.Other Comments: See Mahpahkum-Ahkwuna/Deserters-Walker Conservancy.

properties.Title: Shelter Passage Islet
properties.Landing Comments: Low gradient beaches in moderately protected bay. Bedrock outcrops. Few drift logs. NW aspect.
properties.Camp Comments: Possible 1 tent site on flat rock with marginal tidal clearance. Upland access moderately easy. Additional 1 upland site with much brushing.
properties.Other Comments: Short carry if flat rock is used.

properties.Title: Wishart Island west
properties.Landing Comments: Easy in sheltered cove on very low gradient large clam bed, gravel beaches with scattered boulders. Beaches mostly flood. Few drift logs. Long carry at low water.
properties.Camp Comments: 1 site on grass under cedar. 1 potential gravel beach top site at Neaps. Upland potential. Easy upland access for additional tent or hammock use with brushing.
properties.Other Comments: Fish farm bunkhouse clearly visible. See Mahpahkum-Ahkwuna/Deserters-Walker Conservancy.

properties.Title: Petes Bay
properties.Landing Comments: Broad shingle, pebble beach of moderate gradient. SW aspect. Exposed to NW.
properties.Camp Comments: Grass areas adjacent to intact (2024) unoccupied furnished house. Much debris, materials near house. Adjacent grassy areas for tents.
properties.Other Comments: House in Rec Site apparently used by locals.

properties.Title: Pages Resort
properties.Landing Comments: Two options: 1. Kayak docking area on the south side of our marina with a lowered launching area and storage both on racks or on the docks.  2. There are campsites right on the water overlooking the bay.  Kayaks can be pulled right up on the shore at these sights.
properties.Camp Comments: Page's Resort has 8 sites within 100 metres and they also have wheelbarrows to make it easier for these and the other 8 sites that are a little farther away.
properties.Other Comments: They are open year-round and have washrooms with showers, a BBQ area, and a grocery and liquor store on site. Book your camping spot on the Page's Resort.. Or email the resort at info@pagesresort.com or phone 250-247-8931. Their address is: 3350 Coast Road, Gabriola Island
